questions.q_en: According to PMBOK as referenced in CCPM Module 02, how is 'Project Initiation' defined?
questions.q_bm: Menurut PMBOK seperti yang dirujuk dalam Modul 02 CCPM, bagaimanakah 'Permulaan Projek' (Project Initiation) ditakrifkan?
options_en: Conducting daily concrete cube crushing tests during superstructure works
Launching a process that can result in the authorization of a new project (or a new project phase)
Closing out the final account and releasing retention money after DLP
Issuing the Certificate of Completion and Compliance (Borang F)
options_bm: Menjalankan ujian mampatan kiub konkrit harian semasa kerja superstruktur
Melancarkan satu proses yang boleh menghasilkan kebenaran rasmi bagi sesuatu projek baharu (atau fasa projek baharu)
Menutup akaun akhir dan melepaskan wang tahanan selepas tamat DLP
Mengeluarkan Perakuan Siap dan Pematuhan (Borang F)
questions.exp_en: Project initiation defines the project and seeks formal authorization to commit resources—occurring at project start and at the start of each phase.
questions.exp_bm: Permulaan projek mentakrifkan projek dan mendapatkan kebenaran rasmi untuk menggerakkan sumber—berlaku pada permulaan projek serta pada awal setiap fasa.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.1 Definition of Project Initiation)

questions.q_en: From a Contractor's perspective in competitive bidding, when does informal initiation begin versus formal project initiation?
questions.q_bm: Dari sudut pandangan Kontraktor dalam pembidaan kompetitif, bilakah permulaan tidak rasmi bermula berbanding permulaan projek secara rasmi?
options_en: Both occur only after the roof slab is cast
Contractors never experience a project initiation phase
Informal initiation starts at the Invitation for Bid (or LOI for negotiated contracts), while formal initiation occurs upon Contract Award
Informal initiation starts at Practical Completion, while formal initiation starts after DLP
options_bm: Kedua-duanya berlaku hanya selepas papak bumbung dituang
Kontraktor tidak pernah melalui fasa permulaan projek
Permulaan tidak rasmi bermula pada Jemputan Membida (atau LOI bagi kontrak rundingan), manakala permulaan rasmi berlaku apabila Kontrak Dianugerahkan
Permulaan tidak rasmi bermula pada Siap Praktikal, manakala permulaan rasmi bermula selepas DLP
questions.exp_en: While a Client initiates a project upon recognizing a business need/opportunity, a Contractor initiates internally at Invitation to Bid/LOI and formally upon Contract Award.
questions.exp_bm: Walaupun Klien memulakan projek apabila mengenal pasti keperluan/peluang perniagaan, Kontraktor memulakannya secara dalaman pada Jemputan Tender/LOI dan secara rasmi apabila Kontrak Dianugerahkan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.1 Definition of Project Initiation)

questions.q_en: Which four contextual drivers form the 'Project Initiation Context' in CCPM Module 02 (Figure 2.0)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah empat pemacu kontekstual yang membentuk 'Konteks Permulaan Projek' dalam Modul 02 CCPM (Rajah 2.0)?
options_en: Arbitration, adjudication, litigation, and mediation
Meeting regulatory/social requirements, satisfying stakeholder needs, creating/improving processes/services, and implementing business/technological strategies
Demolition, piling, painting, and landscaping
Hiring security guards, ordering stationery, opening a bank account, and printing brochures
options_bm: Timbang tara, adjudikasi, litigasi, dan mediasi
Memenuhi keperluan perundangan/sosial, memenuhi keperluan pihak berkepentingan, mencipta/menambah baik proses/perkhidmatan, dan melaksanakan strategi perniagaan/teknologi
Perobohan, kerja cerucuk, mengecat, dan landskap
Menggaji pengawal keselamatan, memesan alat tulis, membuka akaun bank, dan mencetak risalah
questions.exp_en: Projects are initiated to satisfy stakeholder requirements, comply with regulatory/social mandates, improve processes/services, or execute business/tech strategies.
questions.exp_bm: Projek dimulakan untuk memenuhi keperluan pihak berkepentingan, mematuhi mandat perundangan/sosial, menambah baik proses/perkhidmatan, atau melaksanakan strategi perniagaan/teknologi.

questions.q_en: In Figure 1.0 of CCPM Module 02, what are the six sequential phases of the Project Management Process?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Rajah 1.0 Modul 02 CCPM, apakah enam fasa berurutan dalam Proses Pengurusan Projek?
options_en: Budgeting -> Advertising -> Selling -> Leasing -> Renovating -> Refinancing
Tendering -> Piling -> Roofing -> Painting -> Handover -> Demolition
Initiation -> Definition -> Designing -> Development -> Implementation -> Closing and Follow-up
Feasibility -> Excavation -> Plumbing -> Electrical -> Plastering -> Audit
options_bm: Pembajetan -> Pengiklanan -> Penjualan -> Penyewaan -> Pengubahsuaian -> Pembiayaan Semula
Tender -> Cerucuk -> Bumbung -> Mengecat -> Penyerahan -> Perobohan
Permulaan -> Pentakrifan -> Reka Bentuk -> Pembangunan -> Pelaksanaan -> Penutupan dan Susulan
Kebolehlaksanaan -> Pengorekan -> Perpaipan -> Elektrikal -> Melepa -> Audit
questions.exp_en: CCPM Module 02 models the project management process in 6 structured phases starting with Phase 1 (Initiation) and Phase 2 (Definition).
questions.exp_bm: Modul 02 CCPM memodelkan proses pengurusan projek dalam 6 fasa berstruktur bermula dengan Fasa 1 (Permulaan) dan Fasa 2 (Pentakrifan).
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.2.1 Fundamentals of Project Initiation)

questions.q_en: What is 'Project Selection' during the early initiation stage?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Pemilihan Projek' (Project Selection) semasa peringkat awal permulaan?
options_en: Evaluating individual or groups of projects and choosing which to initiate so organizational objectives are achieved
Selecting the colour of the safety helmets on site
Selecting which brand of ceramic tiles to install in washrooms
Choosing which subcontractor will supply tower cranes
options_bm: Menilai projek individu atau kumpulan projek dan memilih mana yang perlu dimulakan agar objektif organisasi tercapai
Memilih warna topi keledar keselamatan di tapak
Memilih jenama jubin seramik untuk dipasang di bilik air
Memilih subkontraktor yang akan membekalkan kren menara
questions.exp_en: Project selection filters competing investment proposals against strategic fit, financial return, and organizational capacity before engaging a Project Manager.
questions.exp_bm: Pemilihan projek menapis cadangan pelaburan yang bersaing berdasarkan kesesuaian strategik, pulangan kewangan, dan kapasiti organisasi sebelum melantik Pengurus Projek.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.1 Definition of Project Initiation)

questions.q_en: Which six core components must be included in a comprehensive 'Project Definition' according to CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah enam komponen teras yang mesti terkandung dalam 'Pentakrifan Projek' (Project Definition) yang menyeluruh mengikut Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Borehole logs, concrete cube results, rebar mill certs, slump tests, air quality, and noise readings
Project objectives, project scope, outline deliverables/outcomes, exclusions, constraints, and interfaces
Architect fee, engineer fee, QS fee, land tax, quit rent, and assessment rate
Tender bond, performance bond, retention sum, LAD rate, insurance policy, and final account
options_bm: Log lubang jara, keputusan kiub konkrit, sijil kilang keluli, ujian slump, kualiti udara, dan bacaan bunyi
Objektif projek, skop projek, garis kasar serahan/hasil, pengecualian, kekangan, dan antara muka (interfaces)
Yuran arkitek, yuran jurutera, yuran QS, cukai tanah, cukai pintu, dan kadar taksiran
Bon tender, bon pelaksanaan, wang tahanan, kadar LAD, polisi insurans, dan akaun akhir
questions.exp_en: Defining objectives, scope, deliverables, exclusions, constraints, and interfaces upfront prevents scope creep and boundary disputes.
questions.exp_bm: Mentakrifkan objektif, skop, serahan, pengecualian, kekangan, dan antara muka sejak awal mengelakkan peluasan skop (scope creep) dan pertikaian sempadan kerja.

questions.q_en: Why is explicitly listing 'Exclusions' inside the Project Definition critical during initiation?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah menyenaraikan 'Pengecualian' (Exclusions) secara eksplisit di dalam Pentakrifan Projek amat kritikal semasa fasa permulaan?
options_en: To exempt the contractor from complying with OSHA 1994
To avoid preparing any drawings during design stage
To exclude the local authority from inspecting the site
To make clear what work or items are NOT included in the project scope/budget, preventing false stakeholder assumptions
options_bm: Untuk mengecualikan kontraktor daripada mematuhi OSHA 1994
Untuk mengelakkan penyediaan sebarang lukisan semasa peringkat reka bentuk
Untuk mengecualikan pihak berkuasa tempatan daripada memeriksa tapak
Untuk menjelaskan kerja atau item yang TIDAK termasuk dalam skop/bajet projek, sekali gus mengelakkan andaian palsu pihak berkepentingan
questions.exp_en: Documenting exclusions (e.g., tenant interior fit-out or loose furniture excluded from base-build D&B scope) prevents costly commercial misunderstandings.
questions.exp_bm: Mendokumenkan pengecualian (contohnya ubah suai dalaman penyewa atau perabot longgar yang dikecualikan daripada skop asas D&B) mengelakkan salah faham komersial yang mahal.

questions.q_en: What is a 'Statement of Need' (Statement of Requirement) in Project Initiation?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Penyataan Keperluan' (Statement of Need / Statement of Requirement) dalam Permulaan Projek?
options_en: A detailed structural rebar bending schedule
An outline document defining the client's operational needs, existing/future premises requirements, allocated budget, assumed programme, and stakeholder benefits
A daily attendance sheet for general labourers
A list of defective items found at the end of the 24-month DLP
options_bm: Jadual lenturan bar tetulang struktur yang terperinci
Dokumen garis kasar yang mentakrifkan keperluan operasi klien, keperluan premis sedia ada/masa depan, bajet diperuntukkan, andaian program, dan manfaat kepada pihak berkepentingan
Lembaran kehadiran harian bagi buruh am
Senarai item kecacatan yang ditemui pada akhir DLP 24 bulan
questions.exp_en: The Statement of Need captures business requirements, budget, assumed timeline, and expected benefits without premature technical design details.
questions.exp_bm: Penyataan Keperluan merangkumi keperluan perniagaan, bajet, andaian garis masa, dan manfaat yang dijangkakan tanpa perincian reka bentuk teknikal yang pramatang.

questions.q_en: Which five elements should a Statement of Need typically contain according to CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima elemen yang lazimnya terkandung dalam Penyataan Keperluan mengikut Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Concrete mix ratios, steel yield strength, wind load, seismic zone, and soil bearing capacity
Bomba certificate, CCC Borang F, TNB meter reading, and IWK bill
Supplier bank accounts, worker passport numbers, crane serial numbers, and fuel receipts
Client's needs & operations, existing premises & future requirements, allocated budget, assumed programme, and project benefits to stakeholders
options_bm: Nisbah bancuhan konkrit, kekuatan alah keluli, beban angin, zon seismik, dan keupayaan galas tanah
Perakuan Bomba, CCC Borang F, bacaan meter TNB, dan bil IWK
Akaun bank pembekal, nombor pasport pekerja, nombor siri kren, dan resit bahan api
Keperluan & operasi klien, premis sedia ada & keperluan masa depan, bajet diperuntukkan, andaian program, dan manfaat projek kepada pihak berkepentingan
questions.exp_en: These 5 business-focused items enable senior management to justify capital allocation before commissioning detailed architectural design.
questions.exp_bm: Lima item berfokuskan perniagaan ini membolehkan pengurusan atasan mewajarkan peruntukan modal sebelum memulakan reka bentuk seni bina terperinci.

questions.q_en: In Project Initiation, what does identifying 'Interfaces' in the Project Definition refer to?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Permulaan Projek, apakah yang dimaksudkan dengan mengenal pasti 'Antara Muka' (Interfaces) dalam Pentakrifan Projek?
options_en: Only the type of fencing around the site canteen
Only the colour of computer screens in the site office
Only the brand of mobile phones used by site engineers
Dependencies and boundary interactions with adjacent properties, existing utilities, statutory authorities, other projects, and end-user operations
options_bm: Hanya jenis pagar di sekeliling kantin tapak
Hanya warna skrin komputer di pejabat tapak
Hanya jenama telefon bimbit yang digunakan oleh jurutera tapak
Kebergantungan dan interaksi sempadan dengan hartanah bersebelahan, utiliti sedia ada, pihak berkuasa berkanun, projek lain, dan operasi pengguna akhir
questions.exp_en: Identifying physical, operational, and statutory interfaces early avoids unexpected clashes with neighbours, road networks, utilities, and phased handovers.
questions.exp_bm: Mengenal pasti antara muka fizikal, operasi, dan berkanun lebih awal mengelakkan pertembungan luar jangka dengan jiran, rangkaian jalan, utiliti, dan penyerahan berfasa.

questions.q_en: In CCPM Module 02 (Figure 4.0), when the traditional 3 primary constraints (Time, Scope, Cost) are expanded into the modern 6 Project Constraints, what are the 6 constraints?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Modul 02 CCPM (Rajah 4.0), apabila 3 kekangan utama tradisional (Masa, Skop, Kos) diperluaskan kepada 6 Kekangan Projek moden, apakah 6 kekangan tersebut?
options_en: Architect, Engineer, QS, Planner, Surveyor, and Contractor
Inception, Design, Tender, Construction, Handover, and Maintenance
Land, Labour, Capital, Entrepreneurship, Tax, and Inflation
Schedule, Scope, Budget, Risk, Resources, and Quality
options_bm: Arkitek, Jurutera, QS, Perancang, Juruukur, dan Kontraktor
Permulaan, Reka Bentuk, Tender, Pembinaan, Penyerahan, dan Penyenggaraan
Tanah, Buruh, Modal, Keusahawanan, Cukai, dan Inflasi
Jadual (Schedule), Skop (Scope), Bajet (Budget), Risiko (Risk), Sumber (Resources), dan Kualiti (Quality)
questions.exp_en: Module 02 notes that 'Cost' evolves to 'Budget', 'Time' to 'Schedule', and three additional constraints are added: Risk, Resources, and Quality.
questions.exp_bm: Modul 02 menyatakan istilah 'Kos' berubah kepada 'Bajet', 'Masa' kepada 'Jadual', dan tiga kekangan tambahan disertakan: Risiko, Sumber, dan Kualiti.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.2.4 Project Scope and Constraints)

questions.q_en: What is the primary purpose of a 'Project Brief' established during the Initiation Phase?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuan utama 'Ringkasan Projek' (Project Brief) yang diwujudkan semasa Fasa Permulaan?
options_en: To list the daily wages of general workers
To outline the project objectives, background, governance framework, deliverables, milestones, risks, and criteria for the Steering Committee to decide whether to proceed
To serve as a monthly progress payment invoice
To replace the detailed structural engineering calculations
options_bm: Untuk menyenaraikan gaji harian pekerja am
Untuk menggariskan objektif projek, latar belakang, rangka kerja tadbir urus, serahan, pencapaian utama, risiko, dan kriteria bagi Jawatankuasa Pemandu memutuskan sama ada projek diteruskan
Untuk berfungsi sebagai invois bayaran kemajuan bulanan
Untuk menggantikan pengiraan kejuruteraan struktur terperinci
questions.exp_en: The Project Brief serves as the foundational governance document enabling executive leadership/PMO to authorize moving into detailed planning and design.
questions.exp_bm: Project Brief berfungsi sebagai dokumen tadbir urus asas yang membolehkan kepimpinan eksekutif/PMO meluluskan peralihan ke peringkat perancangan dan reka bentuk terperinci.

questions.q_en: Which five supporting studies or reports typically feed information into the development of a comprehensive Project Brief?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima kajian atau laporan sokongan yang lazimnya menyalurkan maklumat ke dalam pembangunan Ringkasan Projek (Project Brief) yang komprehensif?
options_en: Borang F, Borang G1–G21, Fire Certificate, TNB Bill, and IWK Receipt
Feasibility Study Report, Value Management Report, Environmental Impact Statement, Stakeholder Impact Assessment, and Project Business Case
Daily Site Diary, Concrete Cube Log, Bar Bending Schedule, Delivery Orders, and Petty Cash Vouchers
As-Built Drawings, O&M Manuals, Spare Parts List, Warranty Cards, and Key Schedule
options_bm: Borang F, Borang G1–G21, Perakuan Bomba, Bil TNB, dan Resit IWK
Laporan Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan, Laporan Pengurusan Nilai, Penyataan Impak Alam Sekitar, Penilaian Impak Pihak Berkepentingan, dan Kes Perniagaan Projek
Diari Tapak Harian, Log Kiub Konkrit, Jadual Lenturan Besi, Pesanan Penghantaran, dan Baucar Tunai Runcit
Lukisan Siap Bina, Manual O&M, Senarai Alat Ganti, Kad Jaminan, dan Jadual Kunci
questions.exp_en: Inputs from Feasibility, Value Management, Environmental, Stakeholder, and Business Case assessments ensure the Project Brief is commercially and technically sound.
questions.exp_bm: Input daripada penilaian Kebolehlaksanaan, Pengurusan Nilai, Alam Sekitar, Pihak Berkepentingan, dan Kes Perniagaan memastikan Project Brief kukuh dari segi komersial dan teknikal.

questions.q_en: How does a 'Design Brief' differ from a 'Project Brief' in CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah 'Ringkasan Reka Bentuk' (Design Brief) berbeza daripada 'Ringkasan Projek' (Project Brief) dalam Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: The Project Brief defines overall project governance and business justification for initiation, whereas the Design Brief translates client vision, site data, technical/ICT/FF&E specs, and constraints into a guiding document for designers
The Project Brief is only for subcontractors while the Design Brief is for bank tellers
The Design Brief is prepared after the building is demolished
There is no difference; both are identical financial audit reports
options_bm: Project Brief mentakrifkan tadbir urus projek dan justifikasi perniagaan keseluruhan, manakala Design Brief menterjemahkan visi klien, data tapak, spesifikasi teknikal/ICT/FF&E, dan kekangan menjadi dokumen panduan pereka bentuk
Project Brief hanya untuk subkontraktor manakala Design Brief untuk juruwang bank
Design Brief disediakan selepas bangunan dirobohkan
Tiada perbezaan; kedua-duanya adalah laporan audit kewangan yang sama
questions.exp_en: The Design Brief operationalizes the Project Brief for the design consultants, specifying functional, spatial, technical, site, and budget parameters.
questions.exp_bm: Design Brief mengoperasikan Project Brief untuk perunding reka bentuk dengan memperincikan parameter fungsi, ruang, teknikal, tapak, dan bajet.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.2.5 & 1.2.6 Project vs. Design Brief)

questions.q_en: Which five essential elements must be included in a well-structured 'Design Brief' according to Section 1.2.6 of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima elemen penting yang mesti disertakan dalam 'Ringkasan Reka Bentuk' (Design Brief) yang tersusun mengikut Seksyen 1.2.6 Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Only the site security guard shift roster
Only the architect's home address and phone number
Only the concrete supplier's price list
Client vision/mission/objectives, site/survey/ground info, technical/ICT/FF&E requirements, specialist component requirements, and planning/budget/programme/milestone requirements
options_bm: Hanya jadual syif pengawal keselamatan tapak
Hanya alamat rumah dan nombor telefon arkitek
Hanya senarai harga pembekal konkrit
Visi/misi/objektif klien, maklumat tapak/ukur/tanah, keperluan teknikal/ICT/FF&E, keperluan komponen pakar, dan keperluan perancangan/bajet/program/pencapaian utama
questions.exp_en: A complete Design Brief gives architects and engineers clear client objectives, ground data, technical/ICT needs, specialist packages, and cost/time limits.
questions.exp_bm: Design Brief yang lengkap memberi arkitek dan jurutera objektif klien yang jelas, data tanah, keperluan teknikal/ICT, pakej pakar, serta had kos/masa.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is one of the five key prerequisites required BEFORE starting a project according to Section 1.2.5 of Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan salah satu daripada lima prasyarat utama yang diperlukan SEBELUM memulakan projek mengikut Seksyen 1.2.5 Modul 02?
options_en: Formal agreement/authorization to proceed from the Project Sponsor alongside understanding of the agreed proposal and corporate project management guidelines
Completion of roof waterproofing ponding tests
Final settlement of all subcontractor retention monies
Issuance of the Certificate of Making Good Defects
options_bm: Persetujuan/kebenaran rasmi untuk meneruskan projek daripada Penaja Projek di samping pemahaman cadangan yang dipersetujui dan garis panduan pengurusan projek korporat
Penyiapan ujian takungan kalis air bumbung
Penyelesaian akhir semua wang tahanan subkontraktor
Pengeluaran Perakuan Siap Membaiki Kecacatan
questions.exp_en: Before initiating work, the CPM needs sponsor authorization, documented proposal scope, business unit alignment, and corporate governance guidelines.
questions.exp_bm: Sebelum memulakan kerja, CPM memerlukan kebenaran penaja, skop cadangan bertulis, penjajaran unit perniagaan, dan garis panduan tadbir urus korporat.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.2.5 Key Points Before Starting)

questions.q_en: Who is typically responsible for authoring the written 'Project Scope' statement during the initiation/early planning stage?
questions.q_bm: Siapakah yang lazimnya bertanggungjawab menggubal penyataan bertulis 'Skop Projek' (Project Scope) semasa peringkat permulaan/perancangan awal?
options_en: The retail shop security guard
The site canteen operator
A well-versed construction professional, specifically the Construction Project Manager (CPM) in consultation with the Client and technical team
The ready-mix concrete truck driver
options_bm: Pengawal keselamatan kedai runcit
Pengusaha kantin tapak
Profesional pembinaan yang berpengalaman luas, khususnya Pengurus Projek Pembinaan (CPM) melalui rundingan bersama Klien dan pasukan teknikal
Pemandu lori konkrit siap bancuh
questions.exp_en: The CPM translates the client's business needs into a clear, unambiguous written scope statement so the team knows exactly what must be delivered.
questions.exp_bm: CPM menterjemahkan keperluan perniagaan klien kepada penyataan skop bertulis yang jelas supaya pasukan mengetahui dengan tepat apa yang mesti diserahkan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (1.2.4 Project Scope and Constraints)

questions.q_en: In the 6-constraint project management model, how does an uncontrolled increase in 'Scope' affect the other constraints?
questions.q_bm: Dalam model pengurusan projek 6-kekangan, bagaimanakah peningkatan 'Skop' yang tidak terkawal mempengaruhi kekangan-kekangan lain?
options_en: It automatically reduces both project cost and duration by half
It eliminates all construction risks
It has zero impact on resources or budget
It increases Schedule duration, requires higher Budget and Resources, and elevates Risk if Quality is to be maintained
options_bm: Ia secara automatik mengurangkan kos dan tempoh projek sebanyak separuh
Ia menghapuskan semua risiko pembinaan
Ia tidak memberi sebarang kesan kepada sumber atau bajet
Ia memanjangkan tempoh Jadual, memerlukan Bajet dan Sumber yang lebih tinggi, serta meningkatkan Risiko jika Kualiti ingin dikekalkan
questions.exp_en: All six constraints are tightly interdependent; expanding scope without adjusting budget, schedule, or resources inevitably degrades quality or increases risk.
questions.exp_bm: Keenam-enam kekangan saling bergantung rapat; meluaskan skop tanpa melaraskan bajet, jadual, atau sumber pasti menjejaskan kualiti atau meningkatkan risiko.

questions.q_en: Why does CCPM Module 02 emphasize capturing 'Lessons Learned' frameworks inside the Project Brief right from the Initiation Phase?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Modul 02 CCPM menekankan penetapan rangka kerja merekod 'Pengajaran yang Diperoleh' (Lessons Learned) di dalam Project Brief sejak Fasa Permulaan lagi?
options_en: Because lessons learned are required by Bomba to approve sprinkler pipes
So historical lessons from past projects inform early risk avoidance and new insights are systematically recorded at every phase gate
To replace the Bill of Quantities
To avoid holding site progress meetings
options_bm: Kerana pengajaran yang diperoleh diperlukan oleh Bomba untuk meluluskan paip pemercik air
Supaya pengajaran sejarah daripada projek terdahulu memandu pencegahan risiko awal dan pengetahuan baharu direkod secara sistematik pada setiap pintu fasa
Untuk menggantikan Senarai Kuantiti
Untuk mengelakkan mesyuarat kemajuan tapak
questions.exp_en: Applying past lessons at initiation avoids repeating historical mistakes, while structured capture builds organizational maturity.
questions.exp_bm: Mengaplikasikan pengajaran lalu pada permulaan mengelakkan pengulangan kesilapan sejarah, manakala perekodan berstruktur membina kematangan organisasi.

questions.q_en: What is the key decision output expected from the Steering Committee / Executive Leadership at the conclusion of the Project Initiation / Brief stage?
questions.q_bm: Apakah output keputusan utama yang dijangkakan daripada Jawatankuasa Pemandu / Kepimpinan Eksekutif pada penghujung peringkat Permulaan Projek / Project Brief?
options_en: Approval of the Final Account statement
Issuance of the Certificate of Practical Completion (CPC)
Release of the second half of retention money
A formal 'Go / No-Go' authorization decision to proceed with detailed design and project execution
options_bm: Kelulusan penyata Akaun Akhir
Pengeluaran Perakuan Siap Praktikal (CPC)
Pelepasan separuh kedua wang tahanan
Keputusan kebenaran rasmi 'Teruskan / Tidak Teruskan' (Go / No-Go) untuk melangkah ke reka bentuk terperinci dan pelaksanaan projek
questions.exp_en: The initiation gate validates whether the project is viable and aligned with corporate strategy before committing major design and construction funds.
questions.exp_bm: Gerbang permulaan mengesahkan sama ada projek berdaya maju dan sejajar dengan strategi korporat sebelum meluluskan dana reka bentuk dan pembinaan yang besar.

questions.q_en: According to Section 2.1 of CCPM Module 02, what are the four (4) functional sub-teams that make up a complete Project Team?
questions.q_bm: Menurut Seksyen 2.1 Modul 02 CCPM, apakah empat (4) sub-pasukan fungsian yang membentuk sebuah Pasukan Projek yang lengkap?
options_en: Design Team, Construction Team, Commercial Team, and Project Management Team
Piling Team, Concreting Team, Plastering Team, and Painting Team
Marketing Team, Sales Team, HR Team, and Payroll Team
Security Team, Cleaning Team, Catering Team, and Gardening Team
options_bm: Pasukan Reka Bentuk (Design), Pasukan Pembinaan (Construction), Pasukan Komersial (Commercial), dan Pasukan Pengurusan Projek (Project Management)
Pasukan Cerucuk, Pasukan Konkrit, Pasukan Melepa, dan Pasukan Mengecat
Pasukan Pemasaran, Pasukan Jualan, Pasukan Sumber Manusia, dan Pasukan Gaji
Pasukan Keselamatan, Pasukan Pembersihan, Pasukan Katering, dan Pasukan Landskap
questions.exp_en: Module 02 divides project human resources into four complementary groups: Design, Construction, Commercial, and Project Management Teams.
questions.exp_bm: Modul 02 membahagikan sumber manusia projek kepada empat kumpulan saling melengkapi: Pasukan Reka Bentuk, Pembinaan, Komersial, dan Pengurusan Projek.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (2.1 Introduction to Project Team)

questions.q_en: In CCPM Module 02 (Section 2.2c), which specialists typically comprise the 'Commercial Team' established at the early strategic planning stage to evaluate economic and financial feasibility?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Modul 02 CCPM (Seksyen 2.2c), pakar manakah yang lazimnya menganggotai 'Pasukan Komersial' (Commercial Team) pada peringkat awal perancangan strategik untuk menilai kebolehlaksanaan ekonomi dan kewangan?
options_en: Bomba Inspector, DOSH Officer, and DOE Auditor
Financial Planning Consultant, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Investment Banker, and Legal Adviser
Soil Driller, Laboratory Technician, and Land Surveyor
Tower Crane Operator, Bar Bender, Scaffolder, and Welder
options_bm: Pemeriksa Bomba, Pegawai DOSH, dan Juruaudit JAS
Perunding Perancangan Kewangan, Akauntan Awam Bertauliah (CPA), Jurubank Pelaburan, dan Penasihat Undang-Undang
Penggerudi Tanah, Juruteknik Makmal, dan Juruukur Tanah
Pengendali Kren Menara, Pembengkok Besi, Pemasang Perancah, dan Pengimpal
questions.exp_en: At strategic inception, the Commercial Team structures project financing, tax/accounting feasibility, investment banking, and legal protection.
questions.exp_bm: Pada peringkat permulaan strategik, Pasukan Komersial menstrukturkan pembiayaan projek, kebolehlaksanaan cukai/perakaunan, perbankan pelaburan, dan perlindungan undang-undang.

questions.q_en: When a Project Management Team brings together specialists from multiple functional organizations (e.g., Design, Commercial, Construction, QHSE) under a CPM, what organizational structure is being utilized?
questions.q_bm: Apabila Pasukan Pengurusan Projek menghimpunkan pakar daripada pelbagai organisasi fungsian (cth. Reka Bentuk, Komersial, Pembinaan, QHSE) di bawah seorang CPM, struktur organisasi apakah yang digunakan?
options_en: Matrix Management (Cross-Functional Team)
Sole Proprietorship
Informal Hobby Club
Purely Hierarchical Military Command
options_bm: Pengurusan Matriks (Pasukan Rentas Fungsi / Cross-Functional Team)
Milikan Tunggal
Kelab Hobi Tidak Rasmi
Rantaian Arahan Ketenteraan Tulen
questions.exp_en: Module 02 notes that cross-functional teams drawn from multiple disciplines/organizations represent Matrix Management.
questions.exp_bm: Modul 02 menyatakan bahawa pasukan rentas fungsi yang dibentuk daripada pelbagai disiplin/organisasi mencerminkan Pengurusan Matriks.

questions.q_en: In Figure 5.0 of CCPM Module 02 (Typical Project Management Team), which five functional managers report directly under the Construction Project Manager (CPM)?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Rajah 5.0 Modul 02 CCPM (Pasukan Pengurusan Projek Tipikal), apakah lima pengurus fungsian yang melapor terus di bawah Pengurus Projek Pembinaan (CPM)?
options_en: Bank Tellers, Insurance Agents, Real Estate Brokers, Auctioneers, and Valuers
Retail Store Managers, Cinema Managers, Valet Managers, Janitors, and Cashiers
Project Control Managers, Design Managers, Construction Managers, QHSE Managers, and Contract Managers
Customs Officers, Immigration Officers, Police Inspectors, Firemen, and Postmen
options_bm: Juruwang Bank, Ejen Insurans, Broker Hartanah, Pelelong, dan Penilai
Pengurus Kedai Runcit, Pengurus Pawagam, Pengurus Valet, Tukang Cuci, dan Juruwang
Pengurus Kawalan Projek, Pengurus Reka Bentuk, Pengurus Pembinaan, Pengurus QHSE, dan Pengurus Kontrak
Pegawai Kastam, Pegawai Imigresen, Inspektor Polis, Anggota Bomba, dan Posmen
questions.exp_en: The typical PMT structure places Project Control, Design, Construction, QHSE, and Contract Managers under the CPM's coordination.
questions.exp_bm: Struktur PMT tipikal meletakkan Pengurus Kawalan Projek, Reka Bentuk, Pembinaan, QHSE, dan Kontrak di bawah penyelarasan CPM.

questions.q_en: In an owner-appointed CPM's scope of services for a Design-and-Build project (Section 2.2d), what is the CPM's key duty during 'Contractor Selection' (v)?
questions.q_bm: Dalam skop perkhidmatan CPM yang dilantik pemilik bagi projek Reka dan Bina (Seksyen 2.2d), apakah tugas utama CPM semasa 'Pemilihan Kontraktor' (v)?
options_en: Review the Contractor's price proposal against approved schematics/details and establish an independent estimate as the basis for negotiation
Allow the contractor to charge any price without checking drawings
Sign blank cheques for the contractor
Eliminate all technical evaluation criteria
options_bm: Menyemak cadangan harga Kontraktor berbanding lukisan skematik/terperinci yang diluluskan dan menyediakan anggaran bebas sebagai asas rundingan
Membenarkan kontraktor mengenakan sebarang harga tanpa menyemak lukisan
Menandatangani cek kosong untuk kontraktor
Menghapuskan semua kriteria penilaian teknikal
questions.exp_en: An independent estimate prepared against approved schematics provides an objective benchmark for commercial negotiation with the D&B contractor.
questions.exp_bm: Anggaran bebas yang disediakan berdasarkan pelan skematik yang diluluskan menjadi penanda aras objektif bagi rundingan komersial dengan kontraktor D&B.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (2.2d Scope of CPM Services)

questions.q_en: During 'Construction Mobilization' (vii) in the CPM's Design-and-Build scope of services, which deliverables must the CPM verify before site works advance?
questions.q_bm: Semasa 'Mobilisasi Pembinaan' (vii) dalam skop perkhidmatan Reka dan Bina CPM, serahan manakah yang mesti disahkan oleh CPM sebelum kerja tapak diteruskan?
options_en: Handover of retail keys to 200 shop tenants
Proper and timely delivery of preliminary works, site office/facilities, insurances, and performance bonds in accordance with the Contract
Issuance of the Certificate of Making Good Defects
Completion of 24-month DLP defect rectification
options_bm: Penyerahan kunci kedai kepada 200 penyewa kedai
Penyampaian kerja preliminari, pejabat/kemudahan tapak, insurans, dan bon pelaksanaan secara teratur dan tepat masa mengikut Kontrak
Pengeluaran Perakuan Siap Membaiki Kecacatan
Penyiapan pembaikan kecacatan DLP 24 bulan
questions.exp_en: Verifying valid CAR/SOCSO insurances, performance bonds, hoarding, and site facilities protects the Employer from Day 1 of site possession.
questions.exp_bm: Mengesahkan insurans CAR/PERKESO yang sah, bon pelaksanaan, pagar adang, dan kemudahan tapak melindungi Majikan sejak Hari Pertama milik tapak.

questions.q_en: How should a CPM execute 'Payment Certification' (x) in a Design-and-Build project according to Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah CPM perlu melaksanakan 'Perakuan Bayaran' (x) dalam projek Reka dan Bina mengikut Modul 02?
options_en: Pay 100% of the contract sum in advance before piling starts
Certify payments based purely on telephone calls without site inspection
Ignore quality non-conformance reports when certifying payment
Verify the Contractor's monthly claim endorsed by the Consultant via joint site inspection, taking into account actual physical progress and quality records
options_bm: Membayar 100% jumlah kontrak terlebih dahulu sebelum kerja cerucuk bermula
Memperakui bayaran berdasarkan panggilan telefon semata-mata tanpa pemeriksaan tapak
Mengabaikan laporan ketidakpatuhan kualiti semasa memperakui bayaran
Mengesahkan tuntutan bulanan Kontraktor yang disokong Perunding melalui pemeriksaan tapak bersama, dengan mengambil kira kemajuan fizikal sebenar dan rekod kualiti
questions.exp_en: Linking monthly payment verification to joint inspections and QA/QC records ensures the Client only pays for compliant, verified work.
questions.exp_bm: Menghubungkan pengesahan bayaran bulanan kepada pemeriksaan bersama dan rekod QA/QC memastikan Klien hanya membayar kerja yang patuh dan disahkan.

questions.q_en: Which disciplines typically form the 'Design Team' listed in Section 2.2a of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Disiplin manakah yang lazimnya membentuk 'Pasukan Reka Bentuk' (Design Team) yang disenaraikan dalam Seksyen 2.2a Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Only crane riggers and concrete finishers
Only landscape gardeners and interior decorators
Town Planning, Architectural, CAAD/BIM, Civil & Structural (C&S), and Mechanical & Electrical (M&E)
Only criminal lawyers and tax accountants
options_bm: Hanya juruikat kren dan tukang kemasan konkrit
Hanya tukang kebun landskap dan penghias dalaman
Perancangan Bandar, Seni Bina, CAAD/BIM, Awam & Struktur (C&S), dan Mekanikal & Elektrikal (M&E)
Hanya peguam jenayah dan akauntan cukai
questions.exp_en: Town Planners, Architects, C&S Engineers, M&E Engineers, and CAD/BIM specialists collaborate to produce statutory and construction drawings.
questions.exp_bm: Perancang Bandar, Arkitek, Jurutera C&S, Jurutera M&E, dan pakar CAD/BIM bekerjasama menghasilkan lukisan berkanun dan lukisan pembinaan.

questions.q_en: What is a core responsibility of every individual member of the Project Management Team listed in Section 2.2d?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tanggungjawab teras bagi setiap ahli individu Pasukan Pengurusan Projek yang disenaraikan dalam Seksyen 2.2d?
options_en: Understanding assigned work, planning activities in detail, delivering within budget/time/quality, and proactively escalating scope, risk, or quality issues to the CPM
Working in isolation without communicating with other disciplines
Issuing verbal variation instructions directly to subcontractors without CPM knowledge
Waiting until the end of the project to report major delays
options_bm: Memahami kerja yang ditugaskan, merancang aktiviti secara terperinci, menyiapkannya dalam bajet/masa/kualiti, dan melaporkan isu skop, risiko, atau kualiti secara proaktif kepada CPM
Bekerja secara bersendirian tanpa berkomunikasi dengan disiplin lain
Mengeluarkan arahan perubahan lisan terus kepada subkontraktor tanpa pengetahuan CPM
Menunggu sehingga akhir projek untuk melaporkan kelewatan besar
questions.exp_en: Proactive status communication and early escalation of scope, risk, and quality issues allow the CPM to intervene before deviations become irreversible.
questions.exp_bm: Komunikasi status secara proaktif dan eskalasi awal isu skop, risiko, dan kualiti membolehkan CPM bertindak sebelum sisihan menjadi tidak terkawal.

questions.q_en: Why does the scope of services of an Owner's Construction Project Manager differ from that of a Contractor's Project Manager?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah skop perkhidmatan Pengurus Projek Pembinaan Pemilik berbeza daripada skop Pengurus Projek Kontraktor?
options_en: Because Owner Project Managers are not allowed to visit the site
Because Contractor Project Managers do not use schedules or budgets
Because their contractual relationships, risk allocations, and commercial objectives differ (Employer governance & value assurance vs. Contractor execution & margin delivery)
Because only one of them needs to follow Malaysian laws
options_bm: Kerana Pengurus Projek Pemilik tidak dibenarkan melawat tapak
Kerana Pengurus Projek Kontraktor tidak menggunakan jadual atau bajet
Kerana hubungan kontrak, pengagihan risiko, dan objektif komersial mereka berbeza (tadbir urus & jaminan nilai Majikan berbanding pelaksanaan & penyampaian margin Kontraktor)
Kerana hanya salah seorang daripada mereka perlu mematuhi undang-undang Malaysia
questions.exp_en: An Owner's CPM protects the Client's business case, governance, and compliance, whereas a Contractor's PM focuses on safe, timely, profitable site delivery.
questions.exp_bm: CPM Pemilik melindungi kes perniagaan, tadbir urus, dan pematuhan Klien, manakala PM Kontraktor menumpukan pada penyampaian tapak yang selamat, tepat masa, dan menguntungkan.

questions.q_en: Which five (5) methods of appointing professional consultants are taught in Section 2.3.1 of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima (5) kaedah pelantikan perunding profesional yang diajar dalam Seksyen 2.3.1 Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Open Tender, Selective Tender, Negotiated Tender, Two-Stage Tender, and Serial Tender
Direct Appointment, Interview and Negotiation, Quality Based Selection (QBS), Fee Bidding, and Request for Proposal (RFP)
Analogous, Parametric, Bottom-Up, Three-Point PERT, and Reserve Analysis
Lottery Draw, Coin Toss, Social Media Poll, Walk-in Auction, and Barter Trade
options_bm: Tender Terbuka, Tender Terpilih, Tender Rundingan, Tender Dua Peringkat, dan Tender Bersiri
Pelantikan Terus (Direct Appointment), Temu Duga dan Rundingan, Pemilihan Berasaskan Kualiti (QBS), Bidaan Yuran (Fee Bidding), dan Permintaan Cadangan (RFP)
Analogi, Parametrik, Bawah-ke-Atas, Tiga-Titik PERT, dan Analisis Rizab
Cabutan Undi, Lambungan Syiling, Undian Media Sosial, Lelongan Terbuka, dan Sistem Barter
questions.exp_en: Module 02 specifies 5 consultant selection routes: Direct Appointment, Interview & Negotiation, Quality Based Selection, Fee Bidding, and RFP.
questions.exp_bm: Modul 02 menetapkan 5 kaedah pemilihan perunding: Pelantikan Terus, Temu Duga & Rundingan, Pemilihan Berasaskan Kualiti, Bidaan Yuran, dan RFP.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (2.3.1 Method of Appointment of Consultants)

questions.q_en: When is the 'Quality Based Selection (QBS)' method (such as a design competition) most appropriate for appointing consultants?
questions.q_bm: Bilakah kaedah 'Pemilihan Berasaskan Kualiti (QBS)' (seperti pertandingan reka bentuk) paling sesuai digunakan untuk melantik perunding?
options_en: When the project is a simple temporary site toilet
When the client wants to hire an unregistered student
When no design drawings are needed at all
When overall project quality, architectural creativity, and technical expertise are the client's primary aim rather than lowest fee
options_bm: Apabila projek hanyalah tandas tapak sementara yang ringkas
Apabila klien ingin menggaji pelajar yang tidak berdaftar
Apabila tiada lukisan reka bentuk diperlukan sama sekali
Apabila kualiti projek keseluruhan, kreativiti seni bina, dan kepakaran teknikal menjadi matlamat utama klien berbanding yuran terendah
questions.exp_en: QBS prioritizes technical skill, innovation, and track record first, followed by mutual fee/scope negotiation with the top-ranked firm.
questions.exp_bm: QBS mengutamakan kemahiran teknikal, inovasi, dan rekod prestasi terlebih dahulu, diikuti rundingan yuran/skop bersama firma terbaik.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (2.3.1 Quality Based Selection Method)

questions.q_en: What is the main advantage of the 'Direct Appointment Method' when engaging a known, experienced consultant?
questions.q_bm: Apakah kelebihan utama 'Kaedah Pelantikan Terus' (Direct Appointment Method) apabila melantik perunding yang dikenali dan berpengalaman?
options_en: It exempts the consultant from BEM/LAM registration
It guarantees zero consultancy fees
It eliminates the need for a Consultancy Agreement
It is the least time-consuming appointment exercise, allowing rapid mobilization of trusted expertise
options_bm: Ia mengecualikan perunding daripada pendaftaran BEM/LAM
Ia menjamin yuran perundingan sifar
Ia menghapuskan keperluan Perjanjian Perundingan
Ia merupakan proses pelantikan yang paling menjimatkan masa, membolehkan mobilisasi kepakaran dipercayai dengan pantas
questions.exp_en: Direct appointment saves procurement lead time when a private developer already has a proven, trusted consultant with relevant sector track record.
questions.exp_bm: Pelantikan terus menjimatkan masa perolehan apabila pemaju swasta sudah mempunyai perunding yang terbukti berwibawa dan berpengalaman dalam sektor berkaitan.

questions.q_en: What document is issued to prospective consultants under the 'Request for Proposal (RFP)' method so they can formulate tailored technical and commercial submissions?
questions.q_bm: Apakah dokumen yang dikeluarkan kepada bakal perunding di bawah kaedah 'Permintaan Cadangan (RFP)' supaya mereka dapat merangka cadangan teknikal dan komersial yang sesuai?
options_en: The RFP document containing the strategic brief (client aspirations, budget, programme), required scope of services, and payment stages
The Final Account Statement
The Piling Penetration Record
The Certificate of Practical Completion
options_bm: Dokumen RFP yang mengandungi ringkasan strategik (aspirasi klien, bajet, program), skop perkhidmatan diperlukan, dan peringkat bayaran
Penyata Akaun Akhir
Rekod Penembusan Cerucuk
Perakuan Siap Praktikal
questions.exp_en: An RFP packages the strategic brief, scope of services, payment milestones, and evaluation criteria for shortlisted consultants.
questions.exp_bm: RFP menghimpunkan ringkasan strategik, skop perkhidmatan, pencapaian bayaran, dan kriteria penilaian untuk perunding yang disenarai pendek.

questions.q_en: Which five key elements formalize a standard 'Consultancy Service Agreement' (Memorandum of Agreement) in Section 2.3.2 of Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima elemen utama yang merasmikan 'Perjanjian Perkhidmatan Perundingan' (Memorandum of Agreement) standard dalam Seksyen 2.3.2 Modul 02?
options_en: Memorandum of Agreement (articles/fees), Terms of Reference (TOR), Scope of Duties, Duration (including DLP), and Deliverables
Concrete slump, rebar diameter, brick strength, paint colour, and tile size
Mall opening hours, cinema ticket prices, parking rates, and tenant advertising rules
Worker canteen menu, bus schedule, uniform size, safety boot brand, and helmet colour
options_bm: Memorandum Perjanjian (artikel/yuran), Terma Rujukan (TOR), Skop Tugas, Tempoh (termasuk DLP), dan Serahan (Deliverables)
Kemerosotan konkrit, diameter keluli, kekuatan bata, warna cat, dan saiz jubin
Waktu operasi pusat beli-belah, harga tiket wayang, kadar parkir, dan peraturan iklan penyewa
Menu kantin pekerja, jadual bas, saiz pakaian seragam, jenama kasut keselamatan, dan warna topi
questions.exp_en: Standard agreements issued by LAM, BEM, and BQSM define the Memorandum of Agreement, TOR, Scope of Duties, Duration (through DLP), and Deliverables.
questions.exp_bm: Perjanjian standard yang dikeluarkan oleh LAM, BEM, dan BQSM mentakrifkan Memorandum Perjanjian, TOR, Skop Tugas, Tempoh (sehingga tamat DLP), dan Serahan.

questions.q_en: In Section 2.3.2e of Module 02, which deliverables are specifically attributed to the 'Quantity Surveyor (QS)' under a standard consultancy agreement?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Seksyen 2.3.2e Modul 02, serahan manakah yang secara khusus dipertanggungjawabkan kepada 'Juruukur Bahan (QS)' di bawah perjanjian perundingan standard?
options_en: Preliminary Estimates, Cost Plan, Detail Estimates, Bill of Quantities (BQ), Tender/Contract Documents, Interim Payment Certificates, and Final Account
Soil Borehole Drilling and Laboratory Triaxial Testing
Architectural Concept Drawings and Facade 3D Perspectives
Reinforced Concrete Structural Design Calculations
options_bm: Anggaran Awalan, Pelan Kos, Anggaran Terperinci, Senarai Kuantiti (BQ), Dokumen Tender/Kontrak, Perakuan Bayaran Interim, dan Akaun Akhir
Penggerudian Lubang Jara Tanah dan Ujian Triaksial Makmal
Lukisan Konsep Seni Bina dan Perspektif 3D Fasad
Pengiraan Reka Bentuk Struktur Konkrit Bertetulang
questions.exp_en: The QS manages financial and contractual documentation from Preliminary Estimates and Cost Plans through BQ, Interim Valuations, and Final Account.
questions.exp_bm: QS mengurus dokumentasi kewangan dan kontrak daripada Anggaran Awalan dan Pelan Kos hingga BQ, Penilaian Interim, dan Akaun Akhir.

questions.q_en: What is the normal contractual 'Duration' of a consultant's service agreement in a building project?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Tempoh' (Duration) kontrak biasa bagi perjanjian perkhidmatan perunding dalam projek bangunan?
options_en: Only until the Development Order is submitted
Only until the roof slab is completed
Only for the first 30 days of piling
In reference to the entire contract period INCLUDING the Defects Liability Period (DLP) and Final Account close-out
options_bm: Hanya sehingga Kebenaran Merancang diserahkan
Hanya sehingga papak bumbung siap
Hanya bagi 30 hari pertama kerja cerucuk
Merujuk kepada keseluruhan tempoh kontrak TERMASUK Tempoh Tanggungan Kecacatan (DLP) dan penutupan Akaun Akhir
questions.exp_en: Consultants remain retained through construction, Practical Completion, the 24-month DLP, CMGD issuance, and Final Account certification.
questions.exp_bm: Perunding kekal dilantik sepanjang pembinaan, Siap Praktikal, DLP 24 bulan, pengeluaran CMGD, dan perakuan Akaun Akhir.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian statutory boards publish standard Memorandum of Agreement forms for Architects, Engineers, and Quantity Surveyors respectively?
questions.q_bm: Lembaga berkanun Malaysia manakah yang menerbitkan borang Memorandum Perjanjian standard masing-masing bagi Arkitek, Jurutera, dan Juruukur Bahan?
options_en: BNM, EPF, and SOCSO
LAM (Board of Architects Malaysia), BEM (Board of Engineers Malaysia), and BQSM (Board of Quantity Surveyors Malaysia)
JPJ, JPN, and JIM
MCMC, TNB, and TM
options_bm: BNM, KWSP, dan PERKESO
LAM (Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia), BEM (Lembaga Jurutera Malaysia), dan BQSM (Lembaga Juruukur Bahan Malaysia)
JPJ, JPN, dan JIM
SKMM, TNB, dan TM
questions.exp_en: LAM, BEM, and BQSM regulate professional registration, scale of fees, and standard Conditions of Engagement in Malaysia.
questions.exp_bm: LAM, BEM, dan BQSM mengawal selia pendaftaran profesional, skala yuran, dan Syarat Pelantikan standard di Malaysia.

questions.q_en: When is the 'Fee Bidding Method' considered appropriate for appointing consultants according to Section 2.3.1(iv)?
questions.q_bm: Bilakah 'Kaedah Bidaan Yuran' (Fee Bidding Method) dianggap sesuai untuk melantik perunding mengikut Seksyen 2.3.1(iv)?
options_en: When buying ready-mix concrete
When the client intends never to pay the consultant
When selecting general site labourers
When the scope of services is clearly defined or unique/specialized and competitive fee comparison is desired alongside capability verification
options_bm: Apabila membeli konkrit siap bancuh
Apabila klien berniat untuk tidak pernah membayar perunding
Apabila memilih buruh am tapak
Apabila skop perkhidmatan ditakrifkan dengan jelas atau unik/khusus dan perbandingan yuran yang kompetitif diingini di samping pengesahan keupayaan
questions.exp_en: Fee bidding invites competitive fee proposals against a defined Terms of Reference while ensuring statutory scale compliance.
questions.exp_bm: Bidaan yuran menjemput cadangan yuran yang kompetitif berdasarkan Terma Rujukan yang jelas sambil memastikan pematuhan skala berkanun.

questions.q_en: Which additional specialist consultants (beyond Architect, C&S, M&E, and QS) are typically engaged on a major urban shopping centre project?
questions.q_bm: Perunding pakar tambahan manakah (selain Arkitek, C&S, M&E, dan QS) yang lazimnya dilantik bagi projek pusat beli-belah bandar berskala besar?
options_en: Only a wedding planner and event DJ
Only a marine biologist and deep-sea diver
Town Planner, Licensed Land Surveyor, Traffic Consultant, Geotechnical Specialist, Environmental/Acoustic Consultant, and Landscape Architect
Only a bakery chef and florist
options_bm: Hanya perancang perkahwinan dan DJ majlis
Hanya ahli biologi marin dan penyelam laut dalam
Perancang Bandar, Juruukur Tanah Berlesen, Perunding Trafik, Pakar Geoteknikal, Perunding Alam Sekitar/Akustik, dan Arkitek Landskap
Hanya tukang masak pastri dan penggubah bunga
questions.exp_en: Urban retail malls require Town Planners (for DO), Licensed Land Surveyors (pre-comp/setting out), Traffic Engineers (TIA), and Geotechnical/Environmental specialists.
questions.exp_bm: Pusat beli-belah bandar memerlukan Perancang Bandar (untuk DO), Juruukur Tanah Berlesen (pra-hitungan/pemancangan), Jurutera Trafik (TIA), dan pakar Geoteknikal/Alam Sekitar.

questions.q_en: Which seven (7) particulars require direct observation and attention during a preliminary 'Site Inspection / Visit' according to Section 3.1.1 of Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuh (7) perkara yang memerlukan pemerhatian dan perhatian langsung semasa 'Lawatan / Pemeriksaan Tapak' awal mengikut Seksyen 3.1.1 Modul 02?
options_en: Stock market index, gold price, currency exchange rate, bank base rate, GDP growth, CPI inflation, and export volume
Retail tenant names, cinema showtimes, parking ticket design, uniform colours, music playlist, Wi-Fi password, and logo font
Concrete cube strength, rebar tensile test, weld X-ray, paint thickness, tile adhesion, lift speed, and chiller COP
Location of site, size & zoning, access to/from site, natural character, man-made structures, vehicular/human/animal movement, and availability of utilities
options_bm: Indeks pasaran saham, harga emas, kadar tukaran mata wang, kadar asas bank, pertumbuhan KDNK, inflasi IHP, dan volum eksport
Nama penyewa runcit, waktu tayangan wayang, reka bentuk tiket parkir, warna pakaian seragam, senarai muzik, kata laluan Wi-Fi, dan fon logo
Kekuatan kiub konkrit, ujian tegangan keluli, X-ray kimpalan, ketebalan cat, lekatan jubin, kelajuan lif, dan COP chiller
Lokasi tapak, saiz & pengezonan, laluan keluar/masuk tapak, ciri semula jadi, struktur buatan manusia, pergerakan kenderaan/manusia/haiwan, dan ketersediaan utiliti
questions.exp_en: These 7 physical site inspection items establish immediate logistical, access, boundary, topographical, and utility constraints.
questions.exp_bm: Tujuh item pemeriksaan fizikal tapak ini mengenal pasti kekangan logistik, laluan masuk, sempadan, topografi, dan utiliti dengan serta-merta.

questions.q_en: Which British Standard / Code of Practice is specifically cited in Section 3.1.1 of CCPM Module 02 as the benchmark guideline for planning and executing Site Investigations?
questions.q_bm: Standard British / Kod Amalan manakah yang dirujuk secara khusus dalam Seksyen 3.1.1 Modul 02 CCPM sebagai garis panduan penanda aras untuk merancang dan melaksanakan Penyiasatan Tapak?
options_en: BS 5930 (Code of Practice for Ground Investigations)
IEC 60364 (Low-Voltage Electrical Installations)
ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Systems)
BS 476 (Fire Tests on Building Materials)
options_bm: BS 5930 (Kod Amalan bagi Penyiasatan Tanah)
IEC 60364 (Pemasangan Elektrik Voltan Rendah)
ISO 14001 (Sistem Pengurusan Alam Sekitar)
BS 476 (Ujian Kebakaran ke atas Bahan Binaan)
questions.exp_en: BS 5930 provides the standard engineering framework for desk studies, borehole spacing, sampling, in-situ SPT/vane tests, and groundwater observations.
questions.exp_bm: BS 5930 menyediakan rangka kerja kejuruteraan standard bagi kajian meja, jarak lubang jara, pensampelan, ujian in-situ SPT/vane, dan pemerhatian air bawah tanah.

questions.q_en: In Section 3.1.2b of Module 02, what are the two stages of Sub-Surface Investigation typically carried out on major construction projects?
questions.q_bm: Dalam Seksyen 3.1.2b Modul 02, apakah dua peringkat Penyiasatan Bawah Permukaan (Sub-Surface Investigation) yang lazimnya dijalankan pada projek pembinaan utama?
options_en: Pre-DLP Investigation and Post-DLP Investigation
Preliminary Subsurface Investigation (to confirm layout/formation levels) and Detailed Subsurface Investigation (to obtain refined soil profile & parameters for optimum foundation design)
Tender Advertising Investigation and Brochure Printing Investigation
Demolition Investigation and Painting Investigation
options_bm: Penyiasatan Pra-DLP dan Penyiasatan Pasca-DLP
Penyiasatan Bawah Permukaan Awalan (mengesahkan susun atur/aras formasi) dan Penyiasatan Bawah Permukaan Terperinci (mendapatkan profil tanah & parameter terperinci bagi reka bentuk asas optimum)
Penyiasatan Pengiklanan Tender dan Penyiasatan Pencetakan Risalah
Penyiasatan Perobohan dan Penyiasatan Mengecat
questions.exp_en: Preliminary SI guides master layout and formation levels, while Detailed SI provides exact SPT N-values, rock coring (RQD), and shear strength for piling design.
questions.exp_bm: SI Awalan memandu susun atur induk dan aras formasi, manakala SI Terperinci membekalkan nilai-N SPT tepat, teras batuan (RQD), dan kekuatan ricih bagi reka bentuk cerucuk.

questions.q_en: How does borehole spacing and location strategy differ between a linear 'Road Alignment' project and a localized 'Building' project according to Section 3.1.2b?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah strategi jarak dan lokasi lubang jara (borehole) berbeza antara projek linear 'Jajaran Jalan' dengan projek 'Bangunan' setempat mengikut Seksyen 3.1.2b?
options_en: Subsoil conditions along a road alignment are highly sensitive to changing regional geology, requiring spacing closely tied to detailed route geology compared to localized building grids
Road alignments never require any boreholes
Buildings require boreholes spaced 50 kilometres apart
Both use identical single-borehole rules regardless of size
options_bm: Keadaan tanah bawah di sepanjang jajaran jalan amat sensitif terhadap perubahan geologi serantau, memerlukan jarak berkait rapat dengan geologi laluan terperinci berbanding grid bangunan setempat
Jajaran jalan tidak pernah memerlukan sebarang lubang jara
Bangunan memerlukan lubang jara berjarak 50 kilometer antara satu sama lain
Kedua-duanya menggunakan peraturan satu lubang jara yang sama tanpa mengira saiz
questions.exp_en: Linear infrastructure traverses varied geological formations, whereas building SI concentrates boreholes across the structural footprint and heavy load zones.
questions.exp_bm: Infrastruktur linear merentasi pelbagai formasi geologi, manakala SI bangunan menumpukan lubang jara merentasi tapak struktur dan zon beban berat.

questions.q_en: Why are 'Soil Classification Tests' highlighted in Section 3.1.2b as among the most important laboratory soil tests?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah 'Ujian Pengelasan Tanah' (Soil Classification Tests) ditekankan dalam Seksyen 3.1.2b sebagai antara ujian makmal tanah yang paling penting?
options_en: Because they determine the retail rental rate per square foot
Because strong empirical correlations exist between basic soil classification properties (particle size, Atterberg limits) and probable engineering behaviour under foundation loading
Because they replace the need for structural steel
Because they tell the architect what colour to paint the lobby
options_bm: Kerana ia menentukan kadar sewa runcit setiap kaki persegi
Kerana wujud korelasi empirikal yang kukuh antara sifat asas pengelasan tanah (saiz zarah, had Atterberg) dengan jangkaan kelakuan kejuruteraan di bawah beban asas
Kerana ia menggantikan keperluan keluli struktur
Kerana ia memberitahu arkitek warna cat untuk lobi
questions.exp_en: Particle size distribution, moisture content, and Atterberg limits enable engineers to classify strata and predict settlement, swelling, and shear behavior.
questions.exp_bm: Taburan saiz zarah, kandungan lembapan, dan had Atterberg membolehkan jurutera mengelaskan lapisan tanah serta meramal enapan, pengembangan, dan kelakuan ricih.

questions.q_en: What is the key difference between 'Surface Investigation' and 'Sub-Surface Investigation' during site due diligence?
questions.q_bm: Apakah perbezaan utama antara 'Penyiasatan Permukaan' (Surface Investigation) dengan 'Penyiasatan Bawah Permukaan' (Sub-Surface Investigation) semasa ketekunan wajar tapak?
options_en: Surface investigation uses satellites only, while sub-surface investigation uses drones only

Surface investigation assesses visible terrain, vegetation, swamps, surface runoff, and exposed strata via walkover inspection, whereas sub-surface investigation uses boring, sampling, and testing to determine underground stratigraphy and groundwater
Surface investigation is done after handover, while sub-surface is done during tender
There is no difference between them
options_bm: Penyiasatan permukaan hanya menggunakan satelit, manakala bawah permukaan hanya menggunakan dron

Penyiasatan permukaan menilai rupa bumi kelihatan, tumbuhan, paya, larian air permukaan, dan strata terdedah melalui lawatan tapak, manakala penyiasatan bawah permukaan menggunakan penggerudian, pensampelan, dan ujian untuk menentukan stratigrafi bawah tanah serta air bumi
Penyiasatan permukaan dibuat selepas serahan, manakala bawah permukaan dibuat semasa tender
Tiada perbezaan antara kedua-duanya
questions.exp_en: Both surface walkover observations and sub-surface borehole data are combined to build a complete geotechnical model of the site.
questions.exp_bm: Kedua-dua pemerhatian lawatan permukaan dan data lubang jara bawah permukaan digabungkan untuk membina model geoteknikal tapak yang lengkap.

questions.q_en: Which seven (7) planning steps must be established when scoping a Soil Investigation programme according to Section 3.1.1?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuh (7) langkah perancangan yang mesti ditetapkan semasa menskopkan program Penyiasatan Tanah mengikut Seksyen 3.1.1?
options_en: Only checking Google Street View from the office
Only measuring the height of nearby trees
Estimated cost/time, frequency/types of in-situ tests/samples, supervision extent, number/location of boreholes, BS 5930 methods, special site precautions, and laboratory testing scheme
Only asking the excavator operator where to dig
options_bm: Hanya menyemak Google Street View dari pejabat
Hanya mengukur ketinggian pokok berhampiran
Anggaran kos/masa, kekerapan/jenis ujian in-situ & sampel, tahap penyeliaan, bilangan/lokasi lubang jara, kaedah BS 5930, langkah berjaga-jaga khas, dan skim ujian makmal
Hanya bertanya kepada pengendali jengkaut di mana hendak menggali
questions.exp_en: Proper SI scoping ensures sufficient borehole depth, accurate SPT/coring intervals, qualified supervision, and targeted lab tests within budget.
questions.exp_bm: Penskopan SI yang teratur memastikan kedalaman lubang jara mencukupi, selang SPT/penggerudian teras tepat, penyeliaan bertauliah, dan ujian makmal bersasar dalam bajet.

questions.q_en: Why must a Geotechnical Engineer check for discrepancies or contradictions across field bore-logs and laboratory test results?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Jurutera Geoteknikal mesti menyemak percanggahan atau ketidakseragaman antara log lubang jara lapangan dengan keputusan ujian makmal?
options_en: To detect sample disturbance, logging errors, or localized geological anomalies (such as karst cavities or boulders) before finalizing foundation design
To delay the project intentionally
To avoid submitting plans to DBKL
To increase the printing cost of the report
options_bm: Untuk mengesan gangguan sampel, ralat pengelogan, atau anomali geologi setempat (seperti rongga batu kapur atau batu tongkol) sebelum memuktamadkan reka bentuk asas
Untuk melambatkan projek secara sengaja
Untuk mengelak menyerahkan pelan kepada DBKL
Untuk meningkatkan kos pencetakan laporan
questions.exp_en: Cross-checking field SPT blow counts against lab classifications prevents misinterpreting corestone boulders as sound bedrock.
questions.exp_bm: Semakan silang kiraan hentaman SPT lapangan dengan pengelasan makmal mengelakkan salah tafsir batu tongkol (corestone) sebagai batuan dasar yang kukuh.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.1.2b Analysis of SI Results)

questions.q_en: What is the role of groundwater level monitoring (e.g., via standpipe piezometers) during sub-surface site investigation?
questions.q_bm: Apakah peranan pemantauan paras air bawah tanah (cth. melalui piezometer paip tegak) semasa penyiasatan tapak bawah permukaan?
options_en: To measure daily rainfall in millimetres
To determine hydrostatic uplift pressure on basement slabs, dewatering requirements during excavation, and groundwater aggressiveness (sulphate/chloride) on concrete piles
To supply drinking water to the shopping mall food court
To test fire sprinkler water pressure
options_bm: Untuk mengukur hujan harian dalam milimeter
Untuk menentukan tekanan apungan hidrostatik pada papak besmen, keperluan penyahairan semasa pengorekan, dan keagresifan air bumi (sulfat/klorida) terhadap cerucuk konkrit
Untuk membekalkan air minuman ke medan selera pusat beli-belah
Untuk menguji tekanan air pemercik kebakaran
questions.exp_en: High water tables in Kuala Lumpur directly govern retaining wall design, basement waterproofing, buoyancy checks, and cement type selection.
questions.exp_bm: Paras air bawah tanah yang tinggi di Kuala Lumpur menentukan secara langsung reka bentuk dinding penahan, kalis air besmen, semakan keapungan, dan pemilihan jenis simen.

questions.q_en: Where should the completed and endorsed Site Investigation Report be lodged, and who relies on it most directly?
questions.q_bm: Di manakah Laporan Penyiasatan Tapak yang lengkap dan disahkan perlu disimpan, dan siapakah yang paling bergantung kepadanya secara langsung?
options_en: Lodged and filed in the Project Implementer's / CPM office to guide C&S and Geotechnical designers in establishing safe foundation and earthwork parameters
Discarded immediately after drilling finishes
Locked away secretly so engineers cannot read it
Sent only to the mall's future cleaning contractor
options_bm: Disimpan dan difailkan di pejabat Pelaksana Projek / CPM untuk memandu pereka C&S dan Geoteknikal dalam menetapkan parameter asas dan kerja tanah yang selamat
Dibuang serta-merta selepas penggerudian selesai
Dikunci secara rahsia supaya jurutera tidak dapat membacanya
Dihantar hanya kepada kontraktor pembersihan pusat beli-belah pada masa depan
questions.exp_en: The SI report is a foundational design input filed centrally for C&S engineers, tenderers, and statutory submissions (such as JMG/DBKL).
questions.exp_bm: Laporan SI ialah input reka bentuk asas yang difailkan secara berpusat untuk jurutera C&S, petender, dan penyerahan berkanun (seperti JMG/DBKL).

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian utility and drainage authorities must be consulted during site investigation to locate existing underground cables, gas pipes, water mains, sewers, and flood levels (Section 3.1.3)?
questions.q_bm: Pihak berkuasa utiliti dan saliran Malaysia manakah yang mesti dirujuk semasa penyiasatan tapak untuk mengesan kabel bawah tanah, paip gas, paip air utama, pembetung, dan aras banjir sedia ada (Seksyen 3.1.3)?
options_en: Only Kementerian Pelancongan and Kraftangan Malaysia
Only Jabatan Penjara and Jabatan Kastam
TNB (electricity), PETRONAS (gas), Air Selangor/SYABAS (water), Telekom Malaysia (telecoms), Indah Water Konsortium (sewerage), and JPS (rivers/flood levels)
Only Jabatan Muzium and Jabatan Perhutanan
options_bm: Hanya Kementerian Pelancongan dan Kraftangan Malaysia
Hanya Jabatan Penjara dan Jabatan Kastam
TNB (elektrik), PETRONAS (gas), Air Selangor/SYABAS (air), Telekom Malaysia (telekomunikasi), Indah Water Konsortium (pembetungan), dan JPS (sungai/aras banjir)
Hanya Jabatan Muzium dan Jabatan Perhutanan
questions.exp_en: Consulting all service providers and verifying with Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) / trial trenches prevents catastrophic utility strikes during piling.
questions.exp_bm: Merujuk semua penyedia perkhidmatan dan mengesahkannya melalui Radar Penembusan Tanah (GPR) / parit cubaan mengelakkan kerosakan utiliti kritikal semasa kerja cerucuk.

questions.q_en: What is 'Ordinance Datum' (Mean Sea Level reference) used for when consulting Jabatan Pengairan dan Saliran (JPS) records during site investigation?
questions.q_bm: Apakah kegunaan 'Datum Ordinan' (rujukan Aras Laut Min) apabila merujuk rekod Jabatan Pengairan dan Saliran (JPS) semasa penyiasatan tapak?
options_en: To determine the weight of steel reinforcement
To calculate the retail rent of upper-floor shops
To set the speed of passenger lifts
To establish known historical flood levels relative to site ground levels so minimum platform and basement crest levels are designed safely above flood risk
options_bm: Untuk menentukan berat tetulang keluli
Untuk mengira sewa runcit kedai tingkat atas
Untuk menetapkan kelajuan lif penumpang
Untuk menentukan aras banjir sejarah yang diketahui berbanding aras tanah tapak supaya aras platform minimum dan puncak besmen direka selamat daripada risiko banjir
questions.exp_en: Relating historical flood levels to Ordinance Datum ensures the Minimum Platform Level (MPL) protects the mall and underground parking from flash floods.
questions.exp_bm: Menghubungkan aras banjir sejarah kepada Datum Ordinan memastikan Aras Platform Minimum (MPL) melindungi pusat beli-belah dan parkir bawah tanah daripada banjir kilat.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.1.3 Flood Levels & Ordinance Datum)

questions.q_en: According to Section 3.1.4 of Module 02, what valuable information can 'Historical Reports' and Local Authority archives provide before site development begins?
questions.q_bm: Menurut Seksyen 3.1.4 Modul 02, apakah maklumat berharga yang boleh dibekalkan oleh 'Laporan Sejarah' (Historical Reports) dan arkib Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan sebelum pembangunan tapak bermula?
options_en: The exact number of cars sold in Malaysia next year
100-year meteorological rainfall/temperature patterns, buried old basements/foundations, Tree Preservation Orders, Listed Buildings, public rights of way, and utility easements
Future cinema box-office ticket sales
Personal bank balances of future shoppers
options_bm: Bilangan tepat kereta yang terjual di Malaysia tahun hadapan
Corak hujan/suhu meteorologi 100 tahun, ruang bawah tanah/asas lama tertimbus, Perintah Pemeliharaan Pokok, Bangunan Warisan, hak lalu lintas awam, dan ismen utiliti
Jualan tiket pecah panggung pawagam pada masa hadapan
Baki akaun bank peribadi pembeli pada masa hadapan
questions.exp_en: Historical records uncover hidden underground obstructions (old basements, piles, wells) and legal restrictions (easements, Tree Preservation Orders) before excavation.
questions.exp_bm: Rekod sejarah mendedahkan halangan bawah tanah tersembunyi (besmen lama, cerucuk, perigi) dan sekatan undang-undang (ismen, Perintah Pemeliharaan Pokok) sebelum pengorekan.

questions.q_en: What is a utility 'Easement' (or Reserve) running across a development site, and how does it constrain building layout?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Ismen' (Easement) atau Rizab utiliti yang merentasi tapak pembangunan, dan bagaimanakah ia mengehadkan susun atur bangunan?
options_en: A bonus floor area granted free by the city council
A legal right-of-way for major infrastructure (e.g., trunk water main, sewer, or HV cable) over which permanent building construction is prohibited unless formally diverted
A permit to block public highways without notice
A discount on cement prices
options_bm: Keluasan lantai bonus yang diberikan percuma oleh majlis bandaraya
Hak laluan sah bagi infrastruktur utama (cth. paip air utama, pembetung, atau kabel voltan tinggi) di mana pembinaan bangunan kekal dilarang kecuali dialihkan secara rasmi
Permit untuk menyekat lebuh raya awam tanpa notis
Diskaun ke atas harga simen
questions.exp_en: Building over a trunk water main or sewer easement without authority approval and diversion is illegal and risks structural collapse.
questions.exp_bm: Membina bangunan di atas ismen paip air utama atau pembetung tanpa kelulusan dan pengalihan pihak berkuasa adalah menyalahi undang-undang serta berisiko runtuh.

questions.q_en: Which five standard sections make up a properly prepared Soil Investigation Report according to Section 3.1.2c of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima bahagian standard yang membentuk Laporan Penyiasatan Tanah yang disediakan dengan teratur mengikut Seksyen 3.1.2c Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Tender Notice, Form of Tender, Bank Guarantee, Interim Certificate, and Final Account
Executive Summary, Marketing Plan, Sales Brochure, Tenant Lease Agreement, and Grand Opening Speech
Introduction, Description of Site Condition, Geology of the Site, Soil Conditions (drawings, field/lab results, groundwater), and Appendices (borehole logs & lab sheets)
Safety Policy, Toolbox Talk Attendance, Accident Form, First Aid List, and Fire Drill Log
options_bm: Notis Tender, Borang Tender, Jaminan Bank, Perakuan Interim, dan Akaun Akhir
Ringkasan Eksekutif, Pelan Pemasaran, Risalah Jualan, Perjanjian Sewa Penyewa, dan Ucapan Perasmian
Pengenalan, Perihalan Keadaan Tapak, Geologi Tapak, Keadaan Tanah (lukisan, keputusan lapangan/makmal, air bumi), dan Lampiran (log lubang jara & helaian makmal)
Polisi Keselamatan, Kehadiran Taklimat Toolbox, Borang Kemalangan, Senarai Pertolongan Cemas, dan Log Latihan Kebakaran
questions.exp_en: Separating factual narrative, geology, generalized subsoil profiles, and raw borehole/lab appendices ensures clear engineering interpretation.
questions.exp_bm: Memisahkan naratif fakta, geologi, profil tanah bawah umum, dan lampiran log lubang jara/makmal mentah memastikan tafsiran kejuruteraan yang jelas.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.1.2c Soil Investigation Report Structure)

questions.q_en: Why should a CPM examine 100-year meteorological rainfall records during the Initiation / Site Investigation stage in Kuala Lumpur?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah CPM perlu meneliti rekod hujan meteorologi 100 tahun semasa peringkat Permulaan / Penyiasatan Tapak di Kuala Lumpur?
options_en: To decide what colour uniforms workers should wear
To size temporary silt traps/sediment basins to JPS MSMA storm standards, design permanent roof/surface drainage, and allow realistic wet-weather float in the programme
To predict the exact hour it will rain two years from now
To avoid installing roof gutters
options_bm: Untuk menentukan warna pakaian seragam yang perlu dipakai pekerja
Untuk mensaizkan perangkap kelodak sementara mengikut standard ribut JPS MSMA, mereka bentuk saliran bumbung/permukaan kekal, dan memperuntukkan apungan cuaca hujan yang realistik dalam jadual
Untuk meramalkan jam tepat hujan akan turun dua tahun dari sekarang
Untuk mengelakkan pemasangan talang bumbung
questions.exp_en: Kuala Lumpur experiences intense inter-monsoon convective storms; rainfall intensity data governs MSMA stormwater detention sizing and earthworks scheduling.
questions.exp_bm: Kuala Lumpur mengalami ribut perolakan antara monsun yang lebat; data keamatan hujan menentukan saiz kolam takungan ribut MSMA dan penjadualan kerja tanah.

questions.q_en: What is a 'Tree Preservation Order' (TPO) mentioned in Section 3.1.4 of Module 02, and why must it be checked before site clearing?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Perintah Pemeliharaan Pokok' (Tree Preservation Order - TPO) yang disebut dalam Seksyen 3.1.4 Modul 02, dan mengapakah ia mesti disemak sebelum pembersihan tapak?
options_en: A landscaping discount voucher
A statutory order under Town and Country Planning legislation prohibiting the felling or lopping of designated mature trees without written Local Authority consent
A rule requiring all trees on site to be cut down within 24 hours
A permit to sell timber logs overseas
options_bm: Baucar diskaun landskap
Perintah berkanun di bawah perundangan Perancangan Bandar dan Desa yang melarang penebangan atau pemangkasan pokok matang yang ditetapkan tanpa kebenaran bertulis Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan
Peraturan yang mewajibkan semua pokok di tapak ditebang dalam masa 24 jam
Permit untuk menjual kayu balak ke luar negara
questions.exp_en: Felling protected trees subject to a TPO under Act 172 / Act 267 carries heavy statutory fines and delays Development Order clearance.
questions.exp_bm: Menebang pokok terlindung di bawah TPO mengikut Akta 172 / Akta 267 boleh dikenakan denda berkanun yang berat dan melewatkan pelepasan Kebenaran Merancang.

questions.q_en: During site reconnaissance, why must 'Public Rights of Way' and pedestrian footpaths crossing or bordering the site be accurately surveyed?
questions.q_bm: Semasa tinjauan tapak, mengapakah 'Hak Lalu Lintas Awam' (Public Rights of Way) dan laluan pejalan kaki yang merentasi atau bersempadan dengan tapak mesti diukur dengan tepat?
options_en: Because public access cannot be arbitrarily blocked without formal diversion approval, and safe pedestrian segregation must be planned before erecting hoarding
Because surveyors get paid per pedestrian counted
Because pedestrians are allowed to walk freely under suspended crane loads
Because public footpaths belong to the main contractor forever
options_bm: Kerana laluan awam tidak boleh disekat sewenang-wenangnya tanpa kelulusan pengalihan rasmi, dan pengasingan pejalan kaki yang selamat mesti dirancang sebelum memasang pagar adang
Kerana juruukur dibayar mengikut bilangan pejalan kaki yang dikira
Kerana pejalan kaki dibenarkan berjalan bebas di bawah beban kren yang tergantung
Kerana laluan pejalan kaki awam menjadi milik kontraktor utama selama-lamanya
questions.exp_en: Maintaining safe, legally approved public walkways protects community safety and prevents municipal enforcement orders.
questions.exp_bm: Mengekalkan laluan awam yang selamat dan diluluskan secara sah melindungi keselamatan komuniti serta mengelakkan perintah penguatkuasaan majlis.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.1.4 Public Rights of Way)

questions.q_en: Which non-destructive geophysical method is commonly paired with trial trenches during utility mapping to detect buried metallic and non-metallic pipes?
questions.q_bm: Kaedah geofizik tanpa musnah manakah yang lazimnya digabungkan dengan parit cubaan (trial trenches) semasa pemetaan utiliti untuk mengesan paip logam dan bukan logam yang tertimbus?
options_en: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) and Electromagnetic Location (EML)
Air Quality High-Volume Sampling
Ultrasonic Concrete Cube Crushing
Sound Level Decibel Metering
options_bm: Radar Penembusan Tanah (GPR) dan Pengesanan Elektromagnetik (EML)
Pensampelan Udara Isipadu Tinggi
Ujian Mampatan Kiub Konkrit Ultrasonik
Meter Desibel Tahap Bunyi
questions.exp_en: GPR + EML scanning verified by hand-dug trial pits accurately locates live TNB, TM, water, and gas services prior to piling.
questions.exp_bm: Imbasan GPR + EML yang disahkan melalui lubang cubaan gali tangan mengesan perkhidmatan hidup TNB, TM, air, dan gas dengan tepat sebelum kerja cerucuk.

questions.q_en: How do 'Restrictive Covenants' on a land title impact project initiation if discovered during legal due diligence?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah 'Kovenan Sekatan' (Restrictive Covenants) pada hakmilik tanah mempengaruhi permulaan projek jika ditemui semasa ketekunan wajar perundangan?
options_en: They exempt the project from Fire Services Act 1988
They have zero legal effect in Malaysia
They automatically double the contractor's profit margin
They legally restrict building height, land use, setback, or density, requiring legal variation/consent before the proposed development can proceed
options_bm: Ia mengecualikan projek daripada Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988
Ia tidak mempunyai sebarang kesan undang-undang di Malaysia
Ia secara automatik menggandakan margin keuntungan kontraktor
Ia mengehadkan ketinggian bangunan, kegunaan tanah, anjakan, atau kepadatan secara sah, memerlukan pindaan/persetujuan undang-undang sebelum pembangunan cadangan boleh diteruskan
questions.exp_en: Title search and covenant verification during initiation prevent designing a 7-storey mall on land restricted to low-rise or non-commercial use.
questions.exp_bm: Carian hakmilik dan pengesahan kovenan semasa permulaan mengelakkan reka bentuk pusat beli-belah 7 tingkat di atas tanah yang terhad kepada kegunaan rendah atau bukan komersial.

questions.q_en: According to Section 3.2.1 of CCPM Module 02, what are the six (6) core areas typically assessed in a construction Feasibility Study?
questions.q_bm: Menurut Seksyen 3.2.1 Modul 02 CCPM, apakah enam (6) bidang teras yang lazimnya dinilai dalam Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan (Feasibility Study) pembinaan?
options_en: Technical capability, Budget/financial resources, Legal requirements, Risk associated with the project, Operation feasibility, and Time
Bricklaying, plastering, tiling, painting, plumbing, and wiring
Tender opening, tender evaluation, letter of award, performance bond, interim certificate, and final account
Logo design, staff uniform, pantry snacks, parking ticket colour, background music, and air freshener
options_bm: Keupayaan teknikal, Bajet/sumber kewangan, Keperluan perundangan, Risiko berkaitan projek, Kebolehlaksanaan operasi, dan Masa
Mengikat bata, melepa, memasang jubin, mengecat, perpaipan, dan pendawaian
Pembukaan tender, penilaian tender, surat setuju terima, bon pelaksanaan, perakuan interim, dan akaun akhir
Reka bentuk logo, pakaian seragam staf, snek pantri, warna tiket parkir, muzik latar, dan penyegar udara
