questions.exp_en: Evaluating Technical, Financial, Legal, Risk, Operational, and Time feasibility establishes whether the project is viable before major capital commitment.
questions.exp_bm: Menilai kebolehlaksanaan Teknikal, Kewangan, Perundangan, Risiko, Operasi, dan Masa menentukan sama ada projek berdaya maju sebelum komitmen modal besar.

questions.q_en: Which five (5) organizational benefits of conducting a thorough Feasibility Study are highlighted in Section 3.2.1 of Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima (5) manfaat organisasi daripada menjalankan Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan yang teliti seperti yang ditekankan dalam Seksyen 3.2.1 Modul 02?
options_en: Allowing construction without building plans
Guaranteeing zero rainfall during construction
Improving project team focus, identifying opportunities, providing valuable decision-making info, narrowing down alternatives, and identifying valid reasons to commence
Eliminating the need for site safety officers
options_bm: Membenarkan pembinaan tanpa pelan bangunan
Menjamin tiada hujan langsung semasa pembinaan
Meningkatkan fokus pasukan projek, mengenal pasti peluang, membekalkan maklumat bernilai untuk keputusan, mengecilkan pilihan alternatif, dan mengenal pasti sebab sah untuk memulakan projek
Menghapuskan keperluan pegawai keselamatan tapak
questions.exp_en: A structured feasibility study filters out unviable options early and aligns stakeholders around a validated business case.
questions.exp_bm: Kajian kebolehlaksanaan berstruktur menapis pilihan yang tidak berdaya maju lebih awal dan menyelaraskan pihak berkepentingan di sekitar kes perniagaan yang disahkan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.2.1 Benefits of Feasibility Study)

questions.q_en: Which six (6) elements must the Construction Project Manager address when specifying the 'Procurement Strategy' at the Business Case stage (Section 3.2.1)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah enam (6) elemen yang mesti ditangani oleh Pengurus Projek Pembinaan apabila menetapkan 'Strategi Perolehan' pada peringkat Kes Perniagaan (Seksyen 3.2.1)?
options_en: Only choosing the cheapest paint brand
Only deciding the site canteen opening hours
Funding processes, contract procurement framework, contracting strategy, financing constraints/spending caps, risk/contingency drawdown processes, and security/IP issues
Only selecting security guard uniforms
options_bm: Hanya memilih jenama cat paling murah
Hanya menentukan waktu operasi kantin tapak
Proses pembiayaan, rangka kerja perolehan kontrak, strategi berkontrak, kekangan pembiayaan/had perbelanjaan, proses pengeluaran risiko/luar jangka, dan isu keselamatan/harta intelek
Hanya memilih pakaian seragam pengawal keselamatan
questions.exp_en: Defining funding approvals, contract route (e.g., Traditional vs. D&B), spending caps, and contingency drawdown rules at business case stage prevents commercial bottlenecks.
questions.exp_bm: Mentakrifkan kelulusan pembiayaan, laluan kontrak (cth. Tradisional lwn. D&B), had perbelanjaan, dan peraturan pengeluaran luar jangka pada peringkat kes perniagaan mengelakkan kesesakan komersial.

questions.q_en: Which modern construction technologies and sustainability initiatives are explicitly listed in Section 3.2.1(d) for evaluation during the Feasibility Study?
questions.q_bm: Teknologi pembinaan moden dan inisiatif kemampanan manakah yang disenaraikan secara eksplisit dalam Seksyen 3.2.1(d) untuk dinilai semasa Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan?
options_en: Asbestos roofing sheets and lead water pipes
Typewriters, carbon paper, slide rules, and telegrams
Coal-fired steam engines and horse-drawn carts
Sustainability (Green & Blue initiatives), Industrialized Building System (IBS), Building Information Modelling (BIM), GIS, Drones, and Building Automation Systems (BAS)
options_bm: Kepingan bumbung asbestos dan paip air plumbum
Mesin taip, kertas karbon, pembaris gelongsor, dan telegram
Enjin stim arang batu dan kereta kuda
Kemampanan (inisiatif Hijau & Biru), Sistem Binaan Berindustri (IBS), Pemodelan Maklumat Bangunan (BIM), GIS, Dron, dan Sistem Automasi Bangunan (BAS)
questions.exp_en: Evaluating BIM, IBS, green building certifications, and BAS during feasibility ensures capital budget and brief requirements support modern delivery.
questions.exp_bm: Menilai BIM, IBS, pensijilan bangunan hijau, dan BAS semasa kebolehlaksanaan memastikan bajet modal dan keperluan ringkasan menyokong penyampaian moden.

questions.q_en: In sustainability planning during project initiation, what do 'Green' and 'Blue' initiatives refer to?
questions.q_bm: Dalam perancangan kemampanan semasa permulaan projek, apakah yang dirujuk oleh inisiatif 'Hijau' (Green) dan 'Biru' (Blue)?
options_en: Importing green tiles and blue glass only
'Green' refers to energy efficiency, low-carbon materials, and vegetation/ecosystems; 'Blue' refers to sustainable water management, rainwater harvesting, and stormwater retention
Hiring workers wearing green shirts and blue trousers
Painting walls green and ceilings blue
options_bm: Mengimport jubin hijau dan kaca biru sahaja
'Hijau' merujuk kepada kecekapan tenaga, bahan rendah karbon, dan tumbuhan/ekosistem; 'Biru' merujuk kepada pengurusan air mampan, penuaian air hujan, dan takungan air ribut
Menggaji pekerja memakai baju hijau dan seluar biru
Mengecat dinding warna hijau dan siling warna biru
questions.exp_en: Green-Blue infrastructure integrates energy/carbon reduction (MyCREST/GBI) with MSMA water-sensitive urban drainage and rainwater harvesting.
questions.exp_bm: Infrastruktur Hijau-Biru menggabungkan pengurangan tenaga/karbon (MyCREST/GBI) dengan saliran bandar peka air MSMA dan penuaian air hujan.

questions.q_en: Why should 'Operation Feasibility' be evaluated during the early Feasibility Study of a commercial shopping centre?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah 'Kebolehlaksanaan Operasi' (Operation Feasibility) perlu dinilai semasa Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan awal bagi sesebuah pusat beli-belah komersial?
options_en: To verify if tower cranes can lift 10 tonnes
To check whether the concrete mixer works properly
To test soil bearing capacity at 20m depth
To verify that once built, the facility can be staffed, maintained, leased, and operated profitably within projected lifecycle OPEX and shopper footfall
options_bm: Untuk mengesahkan sama ada kren menara boleh mengangkat 10 tan
Untuk menyemak sama ada pembancuh konkrit berfungsi dengan baik
Untuk menguji keupayaan galas tanah pada kedalaman 20m

Untuk mengesahkan bahawa setelah siap dibina, fasiliti tersebut boleh dikendalikan, disenggara, disewakan, dan dioperasikan secara menguntungkan dalam unjuran OPEX kitaran hayat dan kehadiran pengunjung
questions.exp_en: A technically buildable mall that cannot attract tenants or suffers unsustainable cooling/maintenance costs fails operational feasibility.
questions.exp_bm: Pusat beli-belah yang boleh dibina secara teknikal tetapi gagal menarik penyewa atau menanggung kos penyejukan/penyenggaraan tidak mampan adalah gagal kebolehlaksanaan operasi.

questions.q_en: How should Feasibility Study findings be documented and stored according to Section 3.2.1 of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah penemuan Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan perlu didokumenkan dan disimpan mengikut Seksyen 3.2.1 Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: In a structured, shareable format named consistently with long-term project and operational needs so the client can make an informed stage-gate decision
Published anonymously on social media
Kept exclusively in one consultant's personal mobile phone
Written informally on loose sticky notes and thrown away
options_bm: Dalam format berstruktur yang mudah dikongsi dan dinamakan secara konsisten mengikut keperluan jangka panjang projek serta operasi supaya klien dapat membuat keputusan pintu peringkat yang tepat
Diterbitkan secara tanpa nama di media sosial
Disimpan secara eksklusif di dalam telefon bimbit peribadi seorang perunding sahaja
Ditulis secara tidak rasmi di atas nota pelekat dan dibuang
questions.exp_en: Consistent document naming and structured reporting enable seamless handover from initiation to design, procurement, and future facilities management.
questions.exp_bm: Penamaan dokumen yang konsisten dan pelaporan berstruktur membolehkan peralihan lancar daripada permulaan kepada reka bentuk, perolehan, dan pengurusan fasiliti masa depan.

questions.q_en: What is 'Portfolio and Programme Consideration' during a project feasibility study (Section 3.2.1g)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Pertimbangan Portfolio dan Program' semasa kajian kebolehlaksanaan projek (Seksyen 3.2.1g)?
options_en: Counting the number of bricks on a pallet
Choosing the font style for the project brochure
Evaluating how the proposed project competes for capital, management bandwidth, and market demand alongside the developer's other ongoing or planned projects
Scheduling the daily lunch break of site workers
options_bm: Mengira bilangan batu bata di atas palet
Memilih gaya fon untuk risalah projek
Menilai bagaimana projek cadangan bersaing untuk mendapatkan modal, kapasiti pengurusan, dan permintaan pasaran di samping projek-projek lain pemaju yang sedang berjalan atau dirancang
Menjadualkan waktu rehat makan tengah hari pekerja tapak
questions.exp_en: Assessing portfolio interdependencies prevents over-stretching corporate cash flow and senior project management talent across concurrent developments.
questions.exp_bm: Menilai saling kebergantungan portfolio mengelakkan tekanan berlebihan ke atas aliran tunai korporat dan bakat pengurusan projek kanan merentasi pembangunan serentak.

questions.q_en: Why is 'Intellectual Property (IP) and Information Security' included as a procurement strategy consideration at the business case stage?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah 'Harta Intelek (IP) dan Keselamatan Maklumat' dimasukkan sebagai pertimbangan strategi perolehan pada peringkat kes perniagaan?
options_en: To hide building plans from DBKL
To avoid paying CIDB levy
To protect proprietary commercial leasing data, confidential cost budgets, and architectural/BIM design ownership across consultants and contractors
To prevent workers from wearing safety harnesses
options_bm: Untuk menyembunyikan pelan bangunan daripada DBKL
Untuk mengelak membayar levi CIDB
Untuk melindungi data penyewaan komersial proprietari, bajet kos sulit, dan pemilikan reka bentuk seni bina/BIM merentasi perunding dan kontraktor
Untuk menghalang pekerja daripada memakai abah-abah keselamatan
questions.exp_en: Clear IP ownership clauses ensure the developer retains legal rights to use, modify, and operate BIM models and design drawings post-handover.
questions.exp_bm: Klausa pemilikan IP yang jelas memastikan pemaju mengekalkan hak undang-undang untuk menggunakan, mengubah suai, dan mengendalikan model BIM serta lukisan reka bentuk selepas serahan.

questions.q_en: What is the relationship between a 'Business Case' and a 'Feasibility Study' during Project Initiation?
questions.q_bm: Apakah hubungan antara 'Kes Perniagaan' (Business Case) dengan 'Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan' (Feasibility Study) semasa Permulaan Projek?
options_en: The Feasibility Study tests technical, financial, legal, and operational viability of options, providing the evidence base that justifies and refines the Business Case
The Business Case is written by the piling subcontractor
They are completely unrelated documents used only after building demolition
The Feasibility Study is only conducted after Practical Completion
options_bm: Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan menguji daya maju teknikal, kewangan, perundangan, dan operasi bagi pilihan-pilihan yang ada, membekalkan asas bukti yang mewajarkan dan memurnikan Kes Perniagaan
Kes Perniagaan ditulis oleh subkontraktor cerucuk
Kedua-duanya ialah dokumen yang langsung tidak berkaitan dan hanya digunakan selepas perobohan bangunan
Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan hanya dijalankan selepas Siap Praktikal
questions.exp_en: Feasibility analysis provides objective data on cost, risk, and options so the Business Case accurately demonstrates return on investment.
questions.exp_bm: Analisis kebolehlaksanaan membekalkan data objektif mengenai kos, risiko, dan pilihan supaya Kes Perniagaan membuktikan pulangan pelaburan dengan tepat.

questions.q_en: Under which section of the Environmental Quality Act 1974 (Act 127) is an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) a mandatory statutory requirement for prescribed activities?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah seksyen manakah dalam Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974 (Akta 127) Penilaian Impak Alam Sekitar (EIA) merupakan keperluan berkanun wajib bagi aktiviti yang ditetapkan?
options_en: Section 35 of CIPAA 2012
Section 25 of the CIDB Act 1994
Section 70 of the Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974
Section 34A of the Environmental Quality Act 1974
options_bm: Seksyen 35 CIPAA 2012
Seksyen 25 Akta CIDB 1994
Seksyen 70 Akta Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan 1974
Seksyen 34A Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974
questions.exp_en: Section 34A of EQA 1974 prohibits commencing any prescribed activity (under the EIA Order 2015) until the Director General of DOE approves the EIA report.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 34A EQA 1974 melarang memulakan sebarang aktiviti ditetapkan (di bawah Perintah EIA 2015) sehingga Ketua Pengarah JAS meluluskan laporan EIA.

questions.q_en: Why must an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) be conducted PRIOR to project approval and physical implementation (Section 3.2.2)?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Penilaian Impak Alam Sekitar (EIA) mesti dijalankan SEBELUM kelulusan projek dan pelaksanaan fizikal (Seksyen 3.2.2)?
options_en: To test the strength of steel reinforcement bars
To identify, predict, and communicate environmental impacts early so mitigating measures are built into design before irreversible damage or costly remedial works occur
To calculate the contractor's corporate income tax
To replace the need for Bomba fire plan approval
options_bm: Untuk menguji kekuatan bar tetulang keluli
Untuk mengenal pasti, meramal, dan menyampaikan impak alam sekitar lebih awal supaya langkah mitigasi diterapkan dalam reka bentuk sebelum kerosakan kekal atau kerja pemulihan mahal berlaku
Untuk mengira cukai pendapatan korporat kontraktor
Untuk menggantikan keperluan kelulusan pelan kebakaran Bomba
questions.exp_en: Early EIA integration avoids environmentally unsuitable layouts and embeds mitigation costs into the initial project budget.
questions.exp_bm: Integrasi EIA awal mengelakkan susun atur yang tidak sesuai dengan alam sekitar dan memasukkan kos mitigasi ke dalam bajet projek permulaan.

questions.q_en: What are the four (4) main functions of a Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) outlined in Section 3.2.3 of CCPM Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Apakah empat (4) fungsi utama Penilaian Impak Trafik (TIA) yang digariskan dalam Seksyen 3.2.3 Modul 02 CCPM?
options_en: Design interior retail shopfronts, select escalator music, price parking tickets, and hire valet drivers
Test concrete cube strength, check rebar spacing, measure slab thickness, and inspect roof trusses
Audit subcontractor payroll, verify green cards, check crane PMA, and issue safety boots
Determine existing/future baseline traffic, estimate trip generation of the proposed development, assess additional traffic impact on road networks, and identify roadway/site-access improvements
options_bm: Mereka bentuk bahagian hadapan kedai runcit, memilih muzik eskalator, menetapkan harga tiket parkir, dan menggaji pemandu valet
Menguji kekuatan kiub konkrit, menyemak jarak tetulang, mengukur ketebalan papak, dan memeriksa kekuda bumbung
Mengaudit gaji subkontraktor, mengesahkan kad hijau, menyemak PMA kren, dan mengeluarkan kasut keselamatan

Menentukan trafik asas sedia ada/masa depan, menganggar penjanaan perjalanan pembangunan cadangan, menilai impak trafik tambahan pada rangkaian jalan, dan mengenal pasti penambahbaikan jalan/akses tapak
questions.exp_en: For a 1,300-parking-bay shopping centre in Setiawangsa, TIA is essential for DBKL Development Order approval to prevent junction gridlock.
questions.exp_bm: Bagi pusat beli-belah berkapasiti 1,300 petak parkir di Setiawangsa, TIA adalah penting bagi kelulusan Kebenaran Merancang DBKL untuk mengelakkan kesesakan simpang.

questions.q_en: According to Section 3.2.4 of CCPM Module 02, what are the five (5) overlapping categories of social impacts evaluated in a Social Impact Assessment (SIA)?
questions.q_bm: Menurut Seksyen 3.2.4 Modul 02 CCPM, apakah lima (5) kategori impak sosial yang bertindih yang dinilai dalam Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA)?
options_en: Piling, Excavation, Concreting, Plastering, and Painting impacts
Concrete, Steel, Timber, Glass, and Aluminium impacts
Lifestyle impacts, Cultural impacts, Community impacts, Quality of life impacts, and Health impacts
Tender, Award, Mobilization, Handover, and DLP impacts
options_bm: Impak Cerucuk, Pengorekan, Konkrit, Melepa, dan Mengecat
Impak Konkrit, Keluli, Kayu, Kaca, dan Aluminium
Impak gaya hidup (Lifestyle), Impak budaya (Cultural), Impak komuniti (Community), Impak kualiti hidup (Quality of life), dan Impak kesihatan (Health)
Impak Tender, Penganugerahan, Mobilisasi, Penyerahan, dan DLP
questions.exp_en: SIA evaluates how a major project alters local community cohesion, lifestyle, cultural heritage, livability/security, and physical/mental well-being.
questions.exp_bm: SIA menilai bagaimana projek besar mengubah kesepaduan komuniti tempatan, gaya hidup, warisan budaya, keselesaan/keselamatan, dan kesejahteraan fizikal/mental.

questions.q_en: In Malaysia (Section 3.2.4 of Module 02), what are the two (2) types of Social Impact Assessment (SIA) reports based on the scale of social impact?
questions.q_bm: Di Malaysia (Seksyen 3.2.4 Modul 02), apakah dua (2) jenis laporan Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA) berdasarkan skala impak sosial?
options_en: Structural SIA Report and Electrical SIA Report
General SIA Report (incorporated inside the Development Proposal Report — DRP for minor impacts) and Detailed SIA Report (a stand-alone report for major impacts requiring extensive negotiation)
Daily SIA Report and Hourly SIA Report
Draft Brochure SIA and Final Receipt SIA
options_bm: Laporan SIA Struktur dan Laporan SIA Elektrikal
Laporan SIA Umum (digabungkan dalam Laporan Cadangan Pemajuan — LCP/DRP bagi impak kecil) dan Laporan SIA Terperinci (laporan berasingan bagi impak besar yang memerlukan rundingan meluas)
Laporan SIA Harian dan Laporan SIA Setiap Jam
SIA Risalah Draf dan SIA Resit Akhir
questions.exp_en: Projects with manageable local impacts include SIA within the Development Proposal Report (DRP), whereas major transformative projects require a stand-alone Detailed SIA.
questions.exp_bm: Projek dengan impak tempatan terkawal memasukkan SIA dalam Laporan Cadangan Pemajuan (DRP), manakala projek berimpak besar memerlukan Laporan SIA Terperinci yang berasingan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.2.4 Types of SIA Report)

questions.q_en: Under the Town and Country Planning Act 1976 (Act 172, Section 20B), which Malaysian planning body reviews major development proposals requiring Social Impact Assessments (SIA)?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Akta Perancangan Bandar dan Desa 1976 (Akta 172, Seksyen 20B), badan perancangan Malaysia manakah yang menyemak cadangan pemajuan utama yang memerlukan Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA)?
options_en: Lembaga Getah Malaysia
Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya (SPR)
Jabatan Kastam Diraja Malaysia
PLANMalaysia (Jabatan Perancangan Bandar dan Desa) / National Physical Planning Council (MPFN) and State Planning Committees
options_bm: Lembaga Getah Malaysia
Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya (SPR)
Jabatan Kastam Diraja Malaysia
PLANMalaysia (Jabatan Perancangan Bandar dan Desa) / Majlis Perancang Fizikal Negara (MPFN) dan Jawatankuasa Perancang Negeri
questions.exp_en: PLANMalaysia enforces the Manual Penyediaan Laporan Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA) under Act 172 alongside Local Planning Authorities.
questions.exp_bm: PLANMalaysia menguatkuasakan Manual Penyediaan Laporan Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA) di bawah Akta 172 bersama Pihak Berkuasa Perancang Tempatan.

questions.q_en: Who typically prepares a Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) for a proposed commercial development?
questions.q_bm: Siapakah yang lazimnya menyediakan Penilaian Impak Trafik (TIA) bagi sesuatu cadangan pembangunan komersial?
options_en: The retail mall security supervisor
The interior curtain supplier
Qualified Traffic Engineers or Town/Traffic Planners appointed by the developer
The site concrete batching plant operator
options_bm: Penyelia keselamatan pusat beli-belah
Pembekal langsir dalaman
Jurutera Trafik atau Perancang Bandar/Trafik bertauliah yang dilantik oleh pemaju
Pengendali loji bancuhan konkrit tapak
questions.exp_en: Registered Traffic Engineers conduct peak-hour junction counts, trip generation modeling, and swept-path/signalization recommendations.
questions.exp_bm: Jurutera Trafik berdaftar menjalankan bancian simpang waktu puncak, pemodelan penjanaan perjalanan, dan cadangan laluan/lampu isyarat.

questions.q_en: How can a Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) directly influence the site layout plan of a 1,300-bay shopping centre during Project Initiation?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah Penilaian Impak Trafik (TIA) boleh mempengaruhi secara langsung pelan susun atur tapak pusat beli-belah 1,300 petak parkir semasa Permulaan Projek?
options_en: By determining the strength of foundation concrete
By selecting the colour of shopping trolleys
By setting the salaries of mall cleaners
By determining the optimal location of ingress/egress gates, deceleration lanes, internal queue storage lengths, and separation of service trucks from shopper cars
options_bm: Dengan menentukan kekuatan konkrit asas
Dengan memilih warna troli beli-belah
Dengan menetapkan gaji tukang cuci pusat beli-belah
Dengan menentukan lokasi optimum pintu masuk/keluar, lorong nyahpecutan, panjang ruang menunggu dalaman, dan pengasingan lori servis daripada kereta pengunjung
questions.exp_en: TIA findings directly shape road widening setbacks, access throat length, and ramp geometry before architectural plans are frozen.
questions.exp_bm: Penemuan TIA membentuk secara langsung anjakan pelebaran jalan, panjang laluan masuk, dan geometri tanjakan sebelum pelan seni bina dibekukan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.2.3 TIA Impact on Site Plan)

questions.q_en: Why does CCPM Module 02 note that stakeholder and statutory consultations during the Feasibility Study should be documented transparently?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Modul 02 CCPM menyatakan bahawa rundingan pihak berkepentingan dan agensi berkanun semasa Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan perlu didokumenkan secara telus?
options_en: To replace the need for a Quantity Surveyor
To avoid obtaining Development Order approval
To record agency conditions, community concerns, and agreed mitigation commitments so they are tracked into design and tender documents
To blame external agencies if the contractor is late
options_bm: Untuk menggantikan keperluan Juruukur Bahan
Untuk mengelak memperoleh kelulusan Kebenaran Merancang
Untuk merekod syarat agensi, kebimbangan komuniti, dan komitmen mitigasi yang dipersetujui supaya ia dijejak masuk ke dalam dokumen reka bentuk dan tender
Untuk menyalahkan agensi luar sekiranya kontraktor lewat
questions.exp_en: Early stakeholder and agency consultation records prevent late objections during OSC 3.0 Plus review or public hearings.
questions.exp_bm: Rekod rundingan awal pihak berkepentingan dan agensi mengelakkan bantahan lewat semasa semakan OSC 3.0 Plus atau pendengaran awam.

questions.q_en: In Malaysia, which three (3) broad statutory/development categories govern Social Impact Assessment (SIA) requirements as illustrated in Figure 7.0 of Module 02?
questions.q_bm: Di Malaysia, apakah tiga (3) kategori perundangan/pembangunan utama yang mengawal selia keperluan Penilaian Impak Sosial (SIA) seperti yang digambarkan dalam Rajah 7.0 Modul 02?
options_en: Category 1: Mega/National-interest projects under Sec 20B Act 172 (MPFN); Category 2: Projects requiring EIA under EQA 1974; Category 3: Local/State planning developments under LPA/State Planning
Category 1: Piling; Category 2: Plastering; Category 3: Painting

questions.q_en: Which five (5) specific initiation risks are highlighted in Section 4.1 of CCPM Module 02 as major threats during the Project Initiation phase?
questions.q_bm: Apakah lima (5) risiko permulaan khusus yang ditekankan dalam Seksyen 4.1 Modul 02 CCPM sebagai ancaman utama semasa fasa Permulaan Projek?
options_en: Concrete honeycombing, roof leakage, lift breakdown, paint peeling, and grass dying
Client changing mind, ambiguous project scope/objectives, lack of skilled human resources, lack of key stakeholder support, and no consensus on project output
Tower crane collapse, trench cave-in, chemical spill, mosquito breeding, and noise complaint
Late final account, unpaid retention, supplier bankruptcy, customs strike, and currency crash
options_bm: Sarang lebah konkrit, kebocoran bumbung, kerosakan lif, cat mengelupas, dan rumput mati
Klien berubah fikiran, skop/objektif projek yang kabur, kekurangan sumber manusia mahir, tiada sokongan pihak berkepentingan utama, dan tiada konsensus mengenai output projek
Keruntuhan kren menara, runtuhan parit, tumpahan bahan kimia, pembiakan nyamuk, dan aduan bunyi
Akaun akhir lewat, wang tahanan tidak dibayar, pembekal muflis, mogok kastam, dan kejatuhan mata wang
questions.exp_en: Initiation risks center on governance, alignment, ambiguous objectives, resource gaps, and conflicting stakeholder expectations.
questions.exp_bm: Risiko permulaan tertumpu pada tadbir urus, penjajaran, objektif yang kabur, kekurangan sumber, dan jangkaan pihak berkepentingan yang bercanggah.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (4.1 Risk Management in Project Initiation)

questions.q_en: How should a Construction Project Manager mitigate the initiation risk of 'No Consensus on Project Output' (Section 4.1e) between the Client and delivery team?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah Pengurus Projek Pembinaan harus memitigasi risiko permulaan 'Tiada Konsensus mengenai Output Projek' (Seksyen 4.1e) antara Klien dan pasukan penyampaian?
options_en: Let subcontractors decide the building's floor count
Start construction immediately and let each team build whatever they imagine
Avoid holding any meetings with the Client until handover
Facilitate structured brief-alignment workshops to document unambiguous, measurable deliverables and acceptance criteria signed off by both sides before detailed design
options_bm: Biarkan subkontraktor menentukan bilangan tingkat bangunan
Mulakan pembinaan serta-merta dan biarkan setiap pasukan membina apa sahaja yang mereka bayangkan
Elakkan mengadakan sebarang mesyuarat dengan Klien sehingga penyerahan
Mengendalikan bengkel penjajaran ringkasan berstruktur untuk mendokumenkan serahan yang jelas serta kriteria penerimaan yang ditandatangani kedua-dua pihak sebelum reka bentuk terperinci
questions.exp_en: Formal written sign-off of the Project Brief and acceptance criteria eliminates conflicting interpretations of the final asset.
questions.exp_bm: Pengesahan bertulis rasmi ke atas Project Brief dan kriteria penerimaan menghapuskan tafsiran yang bercanggah mengenai aset akhir.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (4.1e No Consensus on Project Output)

questions.q_en: In our Setiawangsa Shopping Centre case study, why did our Initiation Plan recommend drilling 8 to 10 deep boreholes (to SPT N >= 50 refusal or 5m into sound bedrock)?
questions.q_bm: Dalam kajian kes Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa kita, mengapakah Pelan Permulaan mencadangkan penggerudian 8 hingga 10 lubang jara dalam (sehingga engganan SPT N >= 50 atau 5m ke dalam batuan dasar kukuh)?
options_en: Because DBKL requires exactly 1 borehole per retail shop
To search for underground oil and natural gas reserves
To install 10 geothermal power plants
Because Setiawangsa sits on Kuala Lumpur's weathered granite/schist formation with variable bedrock depth, and verified borehole logs are needed across the 468,000 sq ft lot before foundation design
options_bm: Kerana DBKL mewajibkan tepat 1 lubang jara bagi setiap kedai runcit
Untuk mencari rizab minyak dan gas asli bawah tanah
Untuk memasang 10 loji janakuasa geoterma

Kerana Setiawangsa terletak di atas formasi granit/syis terluluhawa Kuala Lumpur dengan kedalaman batuan dasar yang berubah-ubah, dan log lubang jara yang disahkan diperlukan merentasi lot 468,000 kps sebelum reka bentuk asas
questions.exp_en: Investing ~RM120k–RM180k in 8–10 deep boreholes prevents RM8M–RM14M in foundation redesign and 6–8 weeks of piling delay.
questions.exp_bm: Melabur ~RM120k–RM180k dalam 8–10 lubang jara dalam mengelakkan RM8J–RM14J kos reka bentuk semula asas dan 6–8 minggu kelewatan cerucuk.
questions.ref: Setiawangsa PA Case Study — M02 Site Due Diligence

questions.q_en: In the Setiawangsa Initiation phase, which four (4) functional team pillars were established under the CPM in Figure M02?
questions.q_bm: Dalam fasa Permulaan Setiawangsa, apakah empat (4) teras pasukan fungsian yang ditubuhkan di bawah CPM dalam Rajah M02?
options_en: Pillar 1: Sand; Pillar 2: Cement; Pillar 3: Aggregate; Pillar 4: Water
Pillar 1: Bricks; Pillar 2: Tiles; Pillar 3: Paint; Pillar 4: Glass
Pillar 1: Retail; Pillar 2: Cinema; Pillar 3: Food Court; Pillar 4: Valet Parking
Pillar 1: Design & Statutory Team; Pillar 2: Commercial & Cost Team; Pillar 3: Construction Delivery Team; Pillar 4: Governance & Assurance Team (QA/QC, HSE, Env.)
options_bm: Teras 1: Pasir; Teras 2: Simen; Teras 3: Batu Baur; Teras 4: Air
Teras 1: Batu Bata; Teras 2: Jubin; Teras 3: Cat; Teras 4: Kaca
Teras 1: Runcit; Teras 2: Pawagam; Teras 3: Medan Selera; Teras 4: Parkir Valet
Teras 1: Pasukan Reka Bentuk & Berkanun; Teras 2: Pasukan Komersial & Kos; Teras 3: Pasukan Penyampaian Pembinaan; Teras 4: Pasukan Tadbir Urus & Jaminan (QA/QC, HSE, Alam Sekitar)
questions.exp_en: Organizing the project team into 4 dedicated pillars ensures complete coverage of design, commercial, site execution, and independent QA/HSE assurance.
questions.exp_bm: Menyusun pasukan projek kepada 4 teras khusus memastikan liputan menyeluruh bagi reka bentuk, komersial, pelaksanaan tapak, dan jaminan QA/HSE bebas.
questions.ref: Setiawangsa PA Case Study — Figure M02 Org Chart

questions.q_en: What is the role of an LJT-licensed Land Surveyor during the Project Initiation stage of the Setiawangsa Shopping Centre?
questions.q_bm: Apakah peranan Juruukur Tanah Berlesen (berdaftar LJT) semasa peringkat Permulaan Projek Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa?
options_en: Conduct concrete cube crushing tests
Approve the contractor's bank overdraft
Verify boundary stones/lot pegs, establish Temporary Benchmarks (TBM), produce certified topographical contour surveys, and later endorse Borang G2 (Setting Out)
Design the chilled-water air-conditioning chillers
options_bm: Menjalankan ujian mampatan kiub konkrit
Meluluskan overdraf bank kontraktor
Mengesahkan batu sempadan/pancang lot, mewujudkan Tanda Aras Sementara (TBM), menghasilkan ukur kontur topografi bertauliah, dan kemudian mengesahkan Borang G2 (Pemancangan Tanda)
Mereka bentuk chiller penyaman udara air dingin
questions.exp_en: Certified boundary and topographical surveys prevent building encroachment onto neighbouring lots and provide accurate existing ground levels for earthworks.
questions.exp_bm: Ukur sempadan dan topografi bertauliah mengelakkan pencerobohan bangunan ke atas lot jiran serta membekalkan aras tanah asal yang tepat bagi kerja tanah.
questions.ref: Setiawangsa PA Case Study — M02 Survey Control

questions.q_en: Why is 'Client Changing Mind' (Section 4.1a) a severe risk during Project Initiation, and how does the CPM control it?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah 'Klien Berubah Fikiran' (Seksyen 4.1a) merupakan risiko serius semasa Permulaan Projek, dan bagaimanakah CPM mengawalnya?
options_en: By never writing down what the Client requested
Frequent changes in concept, retail mix, or parking count invalidate feasibility studies and delay OSC submissions; controlled via a formal Concept Freeze Gate and Change Request protocol
By ignoring all emails from the Client
By charging the Client RM1 million every time they ask a question
options_bm: Dengan tidak pernah menulis apa yang diminta oleh Klien

Perubahan kerap pada konsep, campuran runcit, atau bilangan parkir membatalkan kajian kebolehlaksanaan dan melewatkan penyerahan OSC; dikawal melalui Pintu Pembekuan Konsep rasmi dan protokol Permintaan Perubahan
Dengan mengabaikan semua e-mel daripada Klien
Dengan mengenakan caj RM1 juta kepada Klien setiap kali mereka bertanya soalan
questions.exp_en: Securing formal sign-off at the Concept Freeze Gate establishes a baseline so subsequent changes undergo documented cost/time impact assessment.
questions.exp_bm: Mendapatkan pengesahan rasmi pada Pintu Pembekuan Konsep mewujudkan garis dasar supaya perubahan berikutnya melalui penilaian impak kos/masa yang didokumenkan.

questions.q_en: When selecting design consultants for a complex seven-storey shopping centre (as in Section 7.1 of Sample PA), which selection method balances technical expertise with fair fee negotiation?
questions.q_bm: Apabila memilih perunding reka bentuk bagi pusat beli-belah tujuh tingkat yang kompleks (seperti dalam Bahagian 7.1 Contoh PA), kaedah pemilihan manakah yang mengimbangkan kepakaran teknikal dengan rundingan yuran yang adil?
options_en: Picking the cheapest bid from firms with zero commercial building experience
Hiring only newly graduated interns without Professional Architects/Engineers
Drawing names randomly out of a hat
Shortlisting experienced retail/commercial firms followed by the Interview and Negotiation Method (or Quality Based Selection)
options_bm: Memilih bidaan termurah daripada firma yang tiada langsung pengalaman bangunan komersial
Menggaji pelatih baharu tamat pengajian sahaja tanpa Arkitek/Jurutera Profesional
Mencabut nama secara rawak dari dalam topi
Menyenarai pendek firma berpengalaman dalam projek runcit/komersial diikuti Kaedah Temu Duga dan Rundingan (atau Pemilihan Berasaskan Kualiti)
questions.exp_en: Complex retail malls require proven experience in atrium smoke control, vertical transport, high-capacity parking, and DBKL/Bomba approvals.
questions.exp_bm: Pusat beli-belah kompleks memerlukan pengalaman terbukti dalam kawalan asap atrium, pengangkutan menegak, parkir berkapasiti tinggi, dan kelulusan DBKL/Bomba.

questions.q_en: What four (4) criteria should Stakeholders evaluate when assessing a Design Team's competency during Project Initiation?
questions.q_bm: Apakah empat (4) kriteria yang perlu dinilai oleh Pihak Berkepentingan semasa menaksir kompetensi Pasukan Reka Bentuk pada fasa Permulaan Projek?
options_en: Experience on similar size/budget/scope projects, track record with similar clients, whole-life costing (LCC/LCA) integration, and sustainability/green rating experience (e.g., MyCREST/GBI)
Ability to mix concrete manually on site
Office interior decor, brand of company cars, number of Instagram followers, and free golf memberships
Willingness to sign Borang F without inspecting the building
options_bm: Pengalaman dalam projek bersaiz/bajet/skop serupa, rekod prestasi dengan klien serupa, integrasi pengekosan kitaran hayat (LCC/LCA), dan pengalaman penarafan kemampanan/hijau (cth. MyCREST/GBI)
Keupayaan membancuh konkrit secara manual di tapak
Hiasan dalaman pejabat, jenama kereta syarikat, bilangan pengikut Instagram, dan keahlian golf percuma
Kesediaan menandatangani Borang F tanpa memeriksa bangunan
questions.exp_en: Evaluating sector track record, whole-life design thinking, and green certification capability ensures the design team can deliver value within budget.
questions.exp_bm: Menilai rekod prestasi sektor, pemikiran reka bentuk kitaran hayat, dan keupayaan pensijilan hijau memastikan pasukan reka bentuk mampu menyampaikan nilai dalam bajet.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 — Design Team Selection Criteria

questions.q_en: What happens if 'Lack of Human Resources' (Section 4.1c) occurs during Project Initiation and key roles (e.g., BIM Coordinator, Senior QS, or MEP Lead) remain vacant?
questions.q_bm: Apakah yang berlaku jika 'Kekurangan Sumber Manusia' (Seksyen 4.1c) berlaku semasa Permulaan Projek dan peranan utama (cth. Penyelaras BIM, QS Kanan, atau Ketua M&E) kekal kosong?
options_en: The local authority provides free engineers to run the project
The project finishes 6 months early automatically
Early baseline estimates, spatial coordination, and authority submissions suffer bottlenecks, causing cascading delays before physical construction even begins
Nothing is affected because vacant roles are unnecessary
options_bm: Pihak berkuasa tempatan membekalkan jurutera percuma untuk mengurus projek
Projek siap 6 bulan lebih awal secara automatik
Anggaran garis dasar awal, penyelarasan ruang, dan penyerahan pihak berkuasa mengalami kesesakan, menyebabkan kelewatan berantaian sebelum pembinaan fizikal bermula
Tiada apa-apa yang terjejas kerana peranan kosong tidak diperlukan
questions.exp_en: Front-loading competent key personnel during initiation is essential to lock accurate baselines and fast-track statutory approvals.
questions.exp_bm: Penempatan awal personel utama yang kompeten semasa permulaan adalah penting untuk mengunci garis dasar yang tepat dan mempercepat kelulusan berkanun.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (4.1c Lack of Human Resources)

questions.q_en: What is the purpose of a 'Site Inspection Checklist' (like Table 7.1 in Sample PA) completed during the initial site visit?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuan 'Senarai Semak Pemeriksaan Tapak' (seperti Jadual 7.1 dalam Contoh PA) yang dilengkapkan semasa lawatan tapak awal?
options_en: To systematically record site boundaries, surrounding land use, road access, terrain/drainage/rock outcrops, existing structures, traffic/pedestrian flow, and visible utilities in a standardized audit format
To list the names of all 200 shop tenants
To record the serial numbers of retail cash registers
To replace the Geotechnical Borehole Log Report
options_bm: Untuk merekod secara sistematik sempadan tapak, guna tanah sekitar, akses jalan, rupa bumi/saliran/singkapan batu, struktur sedia ada, aliran trafik/pejalan kaki, dan utiliti kelihatan dalam format audit seragam
Untuk menyenaraikan nama kesemua 200 penyewa kedai
Untuk merekod nombor siri mesin juruwang runcit
Untuk menggantikan Laporan Log Lubang Jara Geoteknikal
questions.exp_en: A structured Site Inspection Checklist ensures no critical surface constraint is overlooked during early design and tender pricing.
questions.exp_bm: Senarai Semak Pemeriksaan Tapak yang berstruktur memastikan tiada kekangan permukaan kritikal terlepas pandang semasa reka bentuk awal dan penentuan harga tender.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: During GPR utility scanning in Week 2 at Setiawangsa, your team discovers an uncharted 600mm Air Selangor trunk water main running diagonally beneath the proposed main shopping mall footprint. What is your immediate CPM decision?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Semasa imbasan utiliti GPR pada Minggu ke-2 di Setiawangsa, pasukan anda menemui paip air utama Air Selangor 600mm yang tidak dipetakan melintang secara pepenjuru di bawah tapak bangunan utama pusat beli-belah. Apakah keputusan segera CPM anda?
options_en: Drive spun piles straight through the 600mm trunk main and hope nobody notices

Hold foundation piling in that zone, verify exact depth/alignment via hand-dug trial trenches, initiate urgent technical consultation with Air Selangor for pipe diversion/protection, and assess cost/programme impact
Cut the water main without notifying Air Selangor
Cover the GPR report and hide it from the C&S Engineer
options_bm: Lantak cerucuk terus menembusi paip utama 600mm tersebut dan berharap tiada siapa perasan

Tahan kerja cerucuk asas di zon tersebut, sahkan kedalaman/jajaran tepat melalui parit cubaan gali tangan, mulakan rundingan teknikal segera dengan Air Selangor untuk pengalihan/perlindungan paip, dan nilai impak kos/program
Potong paip air utama tersebut tanpa memaklumkan Air Selangor
Sembunyikan laporan GPR dan rahsiakannya daripada Jurutera C&S
questions.exp_en: Striking a 600mm trunk water main causes catastrophic flooding, water supply disruption across Setiawangsa, heavy statutory penalties, and months of delay.
questions.exp_bm: Melanggar paip air utama 600mm menyebabkan banjir besar, gangguan bekalan air di seluruh Setiawangsa, penalti berkanun berat, dan kelewatan berbulan-bulan.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Preliminary borehole logs (BH1–BH4) at Setiawangsa reveal soft silty clay down to 18m with highly undulating granite bedrock varying from 15m to 28m depth. How must this finding reshape your Initiation & Feasibility report?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Log lubang jara awalan (BH1–BH4) di Setiawangsa mendedahkan tanah liat berkelodak lembut sehingga 18m dengan batuan dasar granit yang sangat beralun dari kedalaman 15m hingga 28m. Bagaimanakah penemuan ini mesti membentuk semula laporan Permulaan & Kebolehlaksanaan anda?
options_en: Assume bedrock is flat at 5 metres everywhere
Ignore the borehole logs and build on 1-metre shallow pad footings
Cancel the Geotechnical Interpretive Report to save RM15,000

Commission additional detailed boreholes (BH5–BH10) to map bedrock contours, adopt deep bored piles/rock-socketing instead of shallow footings, and ring-fence substructure contingency within the RM180.5M budget
options_bm: Andaikan batuan dasar adalah rata pada kedalaman 5 meter di semua tempat
Abaikan log lubang jara dan bina di atas asas pad cetek 1 meter
Batalkan Laporan Tafsiran Geoteknikal untuk menjimatkan RM15,000

Lantik lubang jara terperinci tambahan (BH5–BH10) untuk memetakan kontur batuan dasar, gunakan cerucuk jara dalam/soket batuan berbanding asas cetek, dan asingkan dana luar jangka substruktur dalam bajet RM180.5J
questions.exp_en: Undulating granite bedrock in Kuala Lumpur requires detailed borehole mapping and rock-socketed piling to prevent differential settlement of a 7-storey structure.
questions.exp_bm: Batuan dasar granit yang beralun di Kuala Lumpur memerlukan pemetaan lubang jara terperinci dan cerucuk bersoket batuan bagi mengelakkan enapan pembezaan struktur 7 tingkat.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: The Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) indicates that 1,300 parking bays exiting onto Jalan Bukit Setiawangsa during Friday evening peak hours will cause severe queue spillback onto the main road. What initiation-stage design adjustment must you mandate?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Penilaian Impak Trafik (TIA) menunjukkan bahawa 1,300 petak parkir yang keluar ke Jalan Bukit Setiawangsa pada waktu puncak petang Jumaat akan menyebabkan barisan kenderaan melimpah ke jalan utama. Apakah pelarasan reka bentuk peringkat permulaan yang mesti anda arahkan?
options_en: Submit the DO without the TIA report
Provide dual separated ingress/egress points with dedicated deceleration/storage lanes, automated license-plate/cashless barrier gantries, and signalized junction upgrades prior to DBKL DO submission
Close the mall every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
Reduce the parking bays from 1,300 to 50 bays without telling the Client
options_bm: Hantar DO tanpa laporan TIA

Sediakan dua titik masuk/keluar berasingan dengan lorong nyahpecutan/menunggu khusus, palang tanpa tunai/pengecaman nombor plat automatik, dan naik taraf lampu isyarat simpang sebelum penyerahan DO DBKL
Tutup pusat beli-belah setiap hari Jumaat, Sabtu, dan Ahad
Kurangkan petak parkir daripada 1,300 kepada 50 petak tanpa memberitahu Klien
questions.exp_en: Incorporating TIA access geometry and high-speed barrier throughput into the concept layout secures DBKL OSC approval and prevents post-opening traffic chaos.
questions.exp_bm: Memasukkan geometri akses TIA dan sistem palang berkelajuan tinggi ke dalam pelan konsep memastikan kelulusan OSC DBKL dan mengelakkan kesesakan trafik selepas pembukaan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.2.3 TIA Site Plan Improvements)

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: During stakeholder consultation in Initiation, nearby Taman Setiawangsa residents object strongly to potential night-time piling noise and construction lorry congestion near a primary school. How do you address this in the Project Brief and SIA?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Semasa rundingan pihak berkepentingan pada fasa Permulaan, penduduk Taman Setiawangsa berhampiran membantah keras potensi bunyi bising cerucuk waktu malam dan kesesakan lori binaan berhampiran sekolah rendah. Bagaimanakah anda menanganinya dalam Project Brief dan SIA?
options_en: Mandate silent hydraulic jack-in/bored piling (no impact drop hammers), restrict heavy haulage outside school drop-off/pick-up hours, erect 2.4m acoustic hoarding, and document these commitments in the SIA/EMP
Tell residents they have no right to complain and drive piles at 2:00 AM
Route all heavy concrete lorries directly through the school gate
Cancel the Social Impact Assessment
options_bm: Wajibkan cerucuk hidraulik senyap/cerucuk jara (tiada tukul hentaman bising), hadkan pengangkutan berat di luar waktu hantar/ambil sekolah, bina pagar akustik 2.4m, dan rekodkan komitmen ini dalam SIA/EMP
Beritahu penduduk mereka tiada hak membantah dan lantak cerucuk pada jam 2:00 pagi
Lalukan semua lori konkrit berat terus melalui pintu pagar sekolah
Batalkan Penilaian Impak Sosial
questions.exp_en: Proactive community mitigation in the SIA/Project Brief prevents public protests, DBKL stop-work interventions, and reputational damage.
questions.exp_bm: Mitigasi komuniti secara proaktif dalam SIA/Project Brief mengelakkan bantahan awam, campur tangan henti kerja DBKL, dan kerosakan reputasi.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Two weeks before Concept Freeze, the Client's Retail Leasing Head demands adding an 8th floor (cinema + rooftop theme park) while insisting the RM180.5M budget and 130-week completion date remain unchanged. As CPM, how do you manage this scope-constraint clash?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Dua minggu sebelum Pembekuan Konsep, Ketua Penyewaan Runcit Klien menuntut penambahan tingkat ke-8 (pawagam + taman tema atas bumbung) sambil berkeras bajet RM180.5J dan tarikh siap 130 minggu kekal tidak berubah. Sebagai CPM, bagaimanakah anda mengurus pertembungan kekangan-skop ini?
options_en: Build the 8th floor without applying for DBKL Building Plan amendment

Demonstrate via the 6-Constraint model that adding a floor increases structural load, GFA, cost, and DO approval time; present quantified CAPEX/schedule options to the Steering Committee for either budget/EOT approval or scope deferral
Delete the Sewage Treatment Plant and Water Tank to pay for the cinema
Agree verbally to add the 8th floor for free and hope costs magically drop
options_bm: Bina tingkat ke-8 tanpa memohon pindaan Pelan Bangunan DBKL

Tunjukkan melalui model 6-Kekangan bahawa menambah satu tingkat meningkatkan beban struktur, GFA, kos, dan masa kelulusan DO; bentangkan pilihan CAPEX/jadual terkuantifikasi kepada Jawatankuasa Pemandu sama ada untuk meluluskan bajet/EOT tambahan atau menangguhkan skop
Buang Loji Kumbahan dan Tangki Air untuk membiayai pawagam tersebut
Setuju secara lisan untuk menambah tingkat ke-8 secara percuma dan berharap kos turun secara ajaib
questions.exp_en: Enforcing the 6-Constraint discipline prevents uncosted scope creep from destabilizing the entire project baseline at initiation.
questions.exp_bm: Menguatkuasakan disiplin 6-Kekangan mengelakkan peluasan skop tanpa kos daripada menggugat keseluruhan garis dasar projek pada peringkat permulaan.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Historical archives at DBKL reveal that the Setiawangsa site previously housed a 1970s industrial warehouse with buried reinforced concrete basements and an underground fuel tank. What initiation actions are mandatory before tendering/piling?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Arkib sejarah di DBKL mendedahkan bahawa tapak Setiawangsa sebelum ini menempatkan gudang industri tahun 1970-an dengan ruang bawah tanah konkrit bertetulang tertimbus dan tangki bahan api bawah tanah. Apakah tindakan permulaan yang wajib sebelum tender/kerja cerucuk?
options_en: Ignore the historical report and let piling rigs hit the buried concrete basement
Include grubbing/demolition of buried obstructions and contaminated-soil environmental remediation (EQA 1974) in the Enabling Works scope, budget, and programme baseline
Pump any old fuel sludge into the municipal monsoon drain
Hide the DBKL archive findings from the Quantity Surveyor
options_bm: Abaikan laporan sejarah dan biarkan mesin cerucuk melanggar ruang bawah tanah konkrit tertimbus
Masukkan kerja pembersihan/perobohan halangan tertimbus dan pemulihan alam sekitar tanah tercemar (EQA 1974) ke dalam skop Kerja Awalan, bajet, dan garis dasar program
Pam sebarang enap cemar bahan api lama ke dalam parit monsun perbandaran
Sembunyikan penemuan arkib DBKL daripada Juruukur Bahan
questions.exp_en: Accounting for buried structures and hydrocarbon contamination upfront avoids major unforeseen-obstruction EOT claims and DOE penalties.
questions.exp_bm: Mengambil kira struktur tertimbus dan pencemaran hidrokarbon sejak awal mengelakkan tuntutan EOT halangan luar jangka yang besar serta penalti JAS.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 02 (3.1.4 Historical Report & Risk Mitigation)

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: During consultant selection, the lowest fee bidder (40% below statutory scale) has zero shopping mall experience and proposes only junior CAD draftsmen, whereas the second bidder has completed three Klang Valley malls with full BIM capability. What is your recommendation?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Semasa pemilihan perunding, pembida yuran terendah (40% di bawah skala berkanun) mempunyai sifar pengalaman pusat beli-belah dan hanya mencadangkan pelukis pelan CAD junior, manakala pembida kedua telah menyiapkan tiga pusat beli-belah di Lembah Klang dengan keupayaan BIM penuh. Apakah cadangan anda?
options_en: Proceed without appointing any Architect
Split the architecture work equally among 10 random freelancers
Recommend the second bidder using Quality Based Selection (QBS) principles—abnormally low fees violate professional scale rules and risk catastrophic BIM/Bomba design delays on a RM180.5M project
Award to the cheapest bidder because design quality does not matter
options_bm: Teruskan tanpa melantik sebarang Arkitek
Bahagikan kerja seni bina secara sama rata kepada 10 pekerja bebas rawak

Cadangkan pembida kedua menggunakan prinsip Pemilihan Berasaskan Kualiti (QBS)—yuran rendah luar biasa melanggar peraturan skala profesional dan berisiko mencetuskan kelewatan reka bentuk BIM/Bomba yang teruk pada projek RM180.5J
Anugerahkan kepada pembida termurah kerana kualiti reka bentuk tidak penting
questions.exp_en: Saving RM200k on consultant fees by hiring an inexperienced team can easily trigger RM10M+ in design rework and LAD delays.
questions.exp_bm: Menjimatkan RM200k yuran perunding dengan menggaji pasukan tidak berpengalaman boleh mencetuskan >RM10J kerja semula reka bentuk dan kelewatan LAD.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: At the end of Project Initiation, you discover that the Design Team, Commercial Team, and Construction Team are working off three different versions of the Project Brief with conflicting retail floor counts. How do you restore governance control?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Pada penghujung Permulaan Projek, anda mendapati Pasukan Reka Bentuk, Pasukan Komersial, dan Pasukan Pembinaan menggunakan tiga versi Project Brief yang berbeza dengan bilangan tingkat runcit yang bercanggah. Bagaimanakah anda memulihkan kawalan tadbir urus?
options_en: Recall and supersede outdated drafts immediately, issue a single controlled 'Rev 0 Frozen Project & Design Brief' signed by the Client, and enforce document revision control across all teams
Allow each team to keep using whichever version they prefer
Stop using document version numbers altogether
Average the floor counts between the three documents
options_bm: Tarik balik dan batalkan draf lama serta-merta, keluarkan satu dokumen terkawal 'Project & Design Brief Beku Rev 0' yang ditandatangani Klien, dan kuatkuasakan kawalan semakan dokumen merentasi semua pasukan
Benarkan setiap pasukan terus menggunakan mana-mana versi yang mereka suka
Hentikan penggunaan nombor versi dokumen sama sekali
Puratakan bilangan tingkat antara ketiga-tiga dokumen tersebut
questions.exp_en: Single-source-of-truth document control at the Initiation Stage Gate prevents multi-discipline misalignment.
questions.exp_bm: Kawalan dokumen sumber tunggal yang sahih pada Pintu Peringkat Permulaan mengelakkan ketidaksejajaran pelbagai disiplin.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: A key financial stakeholder (the project's syndicated bank lender) hesitates to approve the first loan drawdown because the Feasibility Study lacks a clear contingency drawdown mechanism and spending cap (Section 3.2.1d & e). How do you resolve this?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Pihak berkepentingan kewangan utama (bank pemberi pinjaman bersindiket projek) teragak-agak untuk meluluskan pengeluaran pinjaman pertama kerana Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan tidak mempunyai mekanisme pengeluaran luar jangka dan had perbelanjaan yang jelas (Seksyen 3.2.1d & e). Bagaimanakah anda menyelesaikannya?
options_en: Ask the bank to transfer the entire RM180.5M into a petty cash box
Delete the contingency line item from the budget
Establish a ring-fenced contingency reserve governed by a formal Change Control & Drawdown Authorization Matrix, paired with monthly cash-flow S-curve caps and independent QS certification
Start construction without any project financing
options_bm: Minta bank memindahkan keseluruhan RM180.5J ke dalam peti tunai runcit
Padamkan item luar jangka daripada bajet
Wujudkan rizab luar jangka terasing yang dikawal oleh Matriks Kawalan Perubahan & Kebenaran Pengeluaran rasmi, digandingkan dengan had lengkung-S aliran tunai bulanan dan perakuan QS bebas
Mulakan pembinaan tanpa sebarang pembiayaan projek
questions.exp_en: Transparent spending caps and ring-fenced contingency governance satisfy lender due diligence and unlock project financing.
questions.exp_bm: Had perbelanjaan yang telus dan tadbir urus luar jangka terasing memenuhi ketekunan wajar pemberi pinjaman dan melancarkan pembiayaan projek.

questions.q_en: FINAL M02 SYNTHESIS: Which statement best summarizes why thorough Project Initiation is the highest-leverage phase for a Construction Project Manager?
questions.q_bm: SINTESIS PENUTUP M02: Penyataan manakah yang paling tepat merumuskan mengapa Permulaan Projek (Project Initiation) yang teliti merupakan fasa berimpak tertinggi bagi seorang Pengurus Projek Pembinaan?
options_en: Because once Initiation ends, the CPM never needs to monitor cost or safety again
Because Initiation replaces the need for Testing & Commissioning
Because Initiation is the only phase where the CPM gets paid

Because locking clear scope, stakeholder consensus, qualified consultants, verified ground/utility data, and statutory feasibility upfront prevents up to 80% of downstream design rework, cost overruns, and disputes
options_bm: Kerana sebaik sahaja Permulaan tamat, CPM tidak perlu lagi memantau kos atau keselamatan
Kerana Permulaan menggantikan keperluan Pengujian & Pentauliahan
Kerana Permulaan ialah satu-satunya fasa di mana CPM dibayar gaji

Kerana mengunci skop yang jelas, konsensus pihak berkepentingan, perunding berkelayakan, data tanah/utiliti yang disahkan, dan kebolehlaksanaan berkanun sejak awal mengelakkan sehingga 80% kerja semula reka bentuk, lebihan kos, dan pertikaian di peringkat hiliran
questions.exp_en: Every RM1 invested in rigorous initiation due diligence (SI, surveys, clear briefs, feasibility) saves multiples in avoided construction variations and LAD.
questions.exp_bm: Setiap RM1 yang dilaburkan dalam ketekunan wajar permulaan yang rapi (SI, ukur, ringkasan jelas, kebolehlaksanaan) menjimatkan berkali ganda kos arahan perubahan dan LAD pembinaan.
